description: At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML, Toolset, and PTC, we’re looking for an **experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance.** **AI is a core part of how we work.** AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience **working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful.** You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. **What You’ll Work On** ----------------------- * **Content strategy and editorial direction** – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. * **Content quality and editing** – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. * **AI-assisted content creation** – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. * **Content performance** – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. * **Content experiments** – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. * **Collaboration with marketing and product teams** – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. **Requirements** **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * You’ve managed **small teams of skilled writers** and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. * You have **excellent editing and copywriting skills**. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. * You know how to use **AI effectively to create and edit content**. * You’re **comfortable working with metrics** and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn’t. * You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. * You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. * You’re **hands-on and independent**. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. * You have experience with **technology, software, SaaS, or technical content**. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in **high-quality editorial environments**, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. **Benefits** **Why Join Us?** OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than **1.5 million websites worldwide**. You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. **If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you.**

The successful candidate will support and streamline procurement workflows, ensure data accuracy and process compliance, and drive operational excellence across the global supplier lifecycle and procure-to-pay processes. The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical capabilities with cross-functional collaboration skills and attention to details and experience managing global procurement processes in a complex, international environment. **Key Responsibilities** **1. Global Supplier Lifecycle Management** * Lead and coordinate end-to-end supplier lifecycle management for vendors outside China or APAC, supporting global sourcing diversification, supply chain resilience, and business continuity objectives. * Manage supplier registration, onboarding, activation, ongoing maintenance, and offboarding in accordance with global procurement policies and business requirements. * Partner with sourcing, legal, finance, tax, compliance, risk management, quality, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure suppliers meet company requirements before engagement and throughout the supplier relationship. * Coordinate supplier due diligence and validation activities, including company registration, tax documentation, banking information, regulatory compliance, risk assessments, and contractual documentation, as applicable. * Oversee supplier master data creation, validation, maintenance, and periodic reviews to ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with internal controls. * Establish and maintain standardized supplier lifecycle procedures, approval workflows, documentation requirements, and service-level agreements across regions and business units. * Monitor supplier lifecycle milestones, documentation validity, compliance status, and outstanding actions to ensure timely completion of required activities and minimize operational disruptions. * Coordinate periodic supplier reviews and revalidation activities, including updates to supplier information, certifications, compliance documentation, and risk profiles, as required. * Identify and resolve supplier-related operational issues, including onboarding delays, master data discrepancies, documentation gaps, compliance exceptions, and supplier status changes. * Coordinate supplier suspension, deactivation, and offboarding activities, ensuring appropriate approvals, system updates, documentation retention, and alignment with outstanding purchasing, invoicing, and payment obligations. * Maintain visibility into supplier lifecycle status, risks, bottlenecks, and escalations through effective reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics. * Drive continuous Performance Management & Continuous Improvement** * Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier onboarding and P2P operations. * Analyze operational data to identify trends, recurring issues, process inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle-time reduction, data quality, process compliance, and stakeholder satisfaction. * Develop regular operational reports and dashboards to provide visibility into workload, service levels, exceptions, and outstanding actions. * Lead cross-functional initiatives to simplify workflows, clarify accountability, and improve end-to-end process performance. * Support change management, stakeholder communication, and training to ensure successful adoption of new processes and systems. **Managerial Responsibilities** This is an independent role at present with the potential to lead a team in the future. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, or related field. * 7+ years of experience in procurement operations or supply chain operations including end to end P2P, preferably in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. * Strong understanding of procurement processes, vendor lifecycle management, vendor master data, and contract management. * identify existing or potential data issues and recommend comprehensive solutions. * Agile and able to adapt to changes quickly, especially in fast-growing environments. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a multinational company. * Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and/or French is a plus. * Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks in a fast-paced environment. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. * Proficiency in Ariba, SAP, SharePoint, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) are preferred. title: Machine Learning Engineer, Computer Vision (NXJ-218)
description: **The Role** ------------ The video understanding pipeline—from multi-object tracking and re-identification to action recognition—is yours to own and scale. The technical challenge lies in balancing high-throughput, low-latency GPU inference with cutting-edge detection accuracy across massive streams of sports footage. You will establish rigorous benchmark suites and decide which vision foundation models make it into production. **About the Product** --------------------- The platform ingests live and recorded sports video to automatically extract real-time metadata, temporal key moments, player statistics, and scene-boundary events. Operating across multiple sports leagues, it relies on frame-accurate video parsing to power downstream broadcast automation, search, and analytics tooling. **Technology Stack:** The core ML pipeline is built in Python using PyTorch for model training and fine-tuning. Production GPU inference is optimized for cost and latency using TensorRT and ONNX Runtime within Dockerized, queue-driven microservices. FFmpeg handles large-scale video decoding, while Azure (Service Bus, Blob Storage) underpins the asynchronous messaging infrastructure. **What You’ll Be Doing** ------------------------ ### **Own and improve the vision services** * Own the video understanding pipeline, including object detection, multi-object tracking, player re-identification, jersey-number recognition and on-screen text recognition (OCR). * Own event and action recognition, including temporal localisation of key moments, shot and scene-boundary detection, replay detection and camera-view classification. * Optimise GPU inference for throughput and cost through batching, precision tuning and compilation. * Monitor production quality and latency, and investigate failures and regressions. ### **Evaluate and test new models** * Build and maintain labelled sports benchmarks, split by sport, league and content type. * Define and track key metrics, including mAP, F1, precision, recall, IoU, latency and GPU cost. * Run systematic bake-offs comparing new detection, tracking, segmentation, re-identification and video foundation models. Reproduce published results on our data. * Write decision memos with clear recommendations, trade-offs and licensing considerations. * Own the regression suite and shadow or A/B testing pipelines, ensuring every model or configuration change is validated before deployment. * Track new papers, model releases and leaderboards, and identify which developments warrant further evaluation. **What We Expect** ------------------ ### **Must have** * 3–5+ years of experience shipping production ML systems, including 2+ years in computer vision, ideally working with video. * Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including hands-on experience profiling and optimising GPU inference using TensorRT and ONNX Runtime. * Hands-on experience in at least two of the following areas: object detection and segmentation (YOLO, DETR-family, SAM), OCR and scene-text recognition, or video action recognition and temporal localisation. * Experience building test sets, calculating evaluation metrics such as mAP, F1 and temporal IoU, and running rigorous model comparisons. * Ability to critically evaluate new research papers and model cards, and reproduce published results. * Production deployment experience with Docker, queue-driven services and cloud GPU infrastructure. * Experience with video processing at scale, including FFmpeg, video decoding pipelines and frame sampling. * Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document technical trade-offs and make clear recommendations. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with Azure (Service Bus, Blob Storage) and message-driven architectures. * Experience with vision-language models and multimodal understanding across video, audio and text. * Experience fine-tuning or adapting vision models to specific domains, particularly sports video. * Experience with self-supervised learning or synthetic data generation to reduce labelling costs. * Familiarity with annotation tools such as CVAT and Label Studio, and experience working with labelling teams. * Experience with shadow deployments and A/B testing. * Familiarity with commercial model licensing. **Why This Role Is Worth Your Time** ------------------------------------ * Direct, unconstrained ownership of the full ML lifecycle—from paper replication and benchmark creation to live GPU optimization. * Production impact at scale, where your model optimization directly lowers real-world infrastructure costs and improves latency on high-volume video data. * High-rigor, evidence-driven engineering environment that prioritizes A/B testing, shadow paths, and statistical validation over hype. ### **Category** Machine Learning · Сomputer Vision ### **Type** ### **Location** hybrid · Poland · Warsaw

In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. **About the Role** ------------------ As part of Haleon's Commercial Digital Services organisation, this role supports the successful deployment and adoption of digital products and platforms that are transforming commercial capabilities, customer engagement, and ways of working across global markets. Working within a large-scale digital transformation portfolio, the position plays an important role in helping markets embed new capabilities and realise measurable business value. We are seeking a Market Deployment & Adoption Analyst to join the Delivery, Deployment & Adoption capability within Haleon's Commercial Digital Services organisation. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that digital products and capabilities are deployed successfully and embedded effectively across global markets. Operating at the intersection of delivery teams, market stakeholders, and behavioural change experts, the Analyst provides hands-on analytical, operational, and change support to help markets adopt new digital tools, integrate them into daily workflows, and realise their intended value. The role requires close collaboration with market teams, product squads, and deployment leads to ensure that adoption challenges are identified early, understood deeply, and resolved quickly. This position is essential to driving consistent uptake of digital capabilities, supporting behaviour change, and ensuring Haleon's global digital transformation achieves measurable impact. **Key responsibilities** **Adoption Tracking & Reporting** * Monitor adoption, usage, and behavioural engagement metrics across multiple markets for digital initiatives. * Create and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and regular reporting to highlight adoption progress, gaps, and risks. * Analyse usage data to identify deviations between expected and actual behaviour and provide actionable insights to deployment teams. Support the development of leading indicators that help predict adoption success and identify at-risk markets early. **Deployment & Change Execution Support** * Assist in preparing markets for go-live by supporting readiness assessments, communication plans, training coordination, and enablement activities. * Coordinate change activities across multiple initiatives, ensuring sequencing avoids saturation or conflicting market priorities. * Identify readiness issues such as capability gaps, bandwidth constraints, or operational blockers and escalate to deployment leads. Support the creation and localisation of change artefacts, user guides, and onboarding materials. **Behavioural Insight & User Support** * Collect and synthesise qualitative feedback from market teams, frontline users, and stakeholders to understand adoption barriers. * Apply behavioural science techniques, such as nudges, prompts, and reinforcement, to encourage adoption and increase engagement. * Segment users based on maturity, role, usage patterns, or market context to tailor support and intervention strategies. Conduct pulse checks, user clinics, and informal check-ins to gather insights and reinforce adoption behaviours. **Value Tracking & Outcome Alignment** * Support alignment of adoption tracking with value KPIs, ensuring activities contribute to measurable business outcomes. * Monitor adoption performance relative to expected business outcomes and identify early signs of value leakage. * Provide insights and analysis to Value Assurance and Deployment Leads to help close value gaps. Contribute to continuous improvement by feeding insights into product, delivery, and deployment teams. **Your profile** **Required qualifications:** * Experience in change analytics, adoption analysis, performance reporting, or similar roles supporting digital, technology, or transformation programmes. * Analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. * Experience collaborating with a variety of stakeholders across markets, commercial teams, and technology functions. Understanding of behavioural insights, user-centred design, or change adoption methodologies. **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience supporting large-scale transformation or digital deployment programmes. * Experience within consumer healthcare, healthcare, FMCG, or similarly regulated industries. * Familiarity with the practical application of behavioural science concepts in change, adoption, or user engagement environments. Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau. **Why Haleon?** None of us should ever feel like we’re standing still. At Haleon, we want you to feel supported, valued, and always progressing. Improving everyday health takes dedication, energy, and effort — so we reward your contribution with a benefits package that includes: * Contract of employment * Annual bonus that reflects performance * Hybrid@Haleon our philosophy to hybrid work (3 days onsite per week) * Private medical package (Medicover) with additional preventive healthcare services for employees and their eligible * Multisport card or points on the Multicafeteria Benefits account * Health and wellbeing programmes that take care of you physically and mentally * Pension plan membership and savings programme (PPE) * Personalized learning paths and access to diverse development tools to support your professional growth. * Generali Life insurance * Supportive community and integration events * Family benefits (extra parental leave, caregiver’s policy) Free car and bike parking #Li-hybrid

title: Senior Technical Animator (contract)
description: **Company Description** To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! **Job Description** **CD PROJEKT RED** is looking for a **Senior Technical Animator** to join our Technical Animation team working on The Witcher 4 ona **6 month fixed-term employment contract**. This is a temporary position covering the absence of an existing team member. In this role, you will focus on the implementation, development, and stabilization of character animation systems using Unreal Engine 5's Unreal Animation Framework (UAF/AnimNext). You will take ownership of existing technical animation solutions, adapt them to the new framework, and ensure they are robust, performant, and reusable across different character types, including NPCs, humanoid enemies, and monsters. We are particularly interested in someone with extensive hands-on Unreal Engine experience who can quickly familiarize themselves with existing systems and independently drive technical solutions to completion. Working with rapidly evolving animation technology requires strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a methodical approach to overcoming technical challenges. We value curiosity about how animation systems work under the hood, including the ability to explore their underlying implementations and code when needed. You'll collaborate closely with Animators, Designers, Programmers, and other Technical Animators to help deliver reliable, high-quality animation systems for The Witcher 4. **Daily Responsibilities:** * Implementing, refactoring, and stabilizing character animation systems within Unreal Engine 5's Unreal Animation Framework (UAF/AnimNext), primarily through editor-based graph and node workflows, including the core architecture, locomotion state machines, animation overlays, and physics-driven animation. * Taking ownership of existing and partially implemented systems, improving their reliability, performance, and reusability across different character types. * Developing and maintaining animation features for NPCs, humanoid enemies, and monsters, including hit reactions, procedural look-at, inverse kinematics (IK), and ragdoll physics. * Investigating and resolving complex animation bugs, crashes, visual artifacts, and performance issues in collaboration with Animation Programmers and other Technical Animators. * Supporting Animators and Designers with animation implementation, content setup, debugging, and tuning to ensure authored animations behave as intended in-game. * Collaborating with other disciplines to integrate animation systems into gameplay, address production requirements, and improve existing technical solutions. * Documenting animation systems and workflows, sharing knowledge, and enabling other team members to independently use and maintain the systems. **Qualifications** * At least 5+ years experience in Technical Animation, preferably on AAA or similarly large-scale/complex game projects. * Extensive hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5 animation systems, including Animation Blueprints, state machines, Control Rig, and procedural animation. * Thorough understanding of character animation, including locomotion, animation layering, inverse kinematics, and physics-driven animation. * Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills, with experience investigating complex runtime issues, animation artifacts, and performance bottlenecks. * Proven ability to quickly understand and take ownership of unfamiliar technical systems, with a methodical and persistent approach to overcoming technical challenges. * Solid understanding of animation principles, body mechanics, and the technical requirements of in-game character animation. * Good working knowledge of Blueprints and the ability to read and navigate C++ code. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to adapt complex technical topics to different discipline perspectives and explain them clearly through discussion and documentation. **Nice to have** * Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine's AnimNext / Unreal Animation Framework (UAF), particularly modular animation graphs and UAF nodes. * Experience implementing animation systems for humanoid enemies, creatures, or monsters. * Experience with Unreal Engine's StateTrees, Physics Assets, Physics Control, and Motion Matching. * Experience migrating or refactoring existing animation systems to new frameworks. * Experience working effectively in agile, cross-disciplinary game development teams. **Additional Information** **Working mode** * Office-First — Working primarily from the Warsaw for a minimum of 10 days per month. * Remote-First — Possibility of remote work from within +/- 3 hours away from Warsaw time zone. **Health & Well-Being** * Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. * Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. * Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. * Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. * Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. * Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. * RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. * RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. **Perks & Professional Growth** * A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. * Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! * REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. * Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! **Social Activities & Life in the Office** * Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. * Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. * Healthy selections — canteens. * Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. * Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog. * A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. * An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. * No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. **Estimated pay range for this position:** 23 700 – 40 700 PLN gross monthly. This role may be eligible for a long term incentive program (option to purchase CDPR stock after the vesting period). Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. **Contract type in Poland:** Employment Contract ("Umowa o pracę"). *If you've observed any irregularities (i.e. legal or ethical violations) in our recruitment process, please click* *here* *to report them anonymously.* #LI\_hybrid #LI\_remote

title: Junior Logistics Specialist - Europe
description: ### **About United Imaging Healthcare** United Imaging Healthcare is a global high-tech medical imaging company providing advanced CT, MRI, PET/CT, molecular imaging and radiotherapy solutions to hospitals and research institutions worldwide. As our European business continues to expand, United Imaging Healthcare Poland is looking for a **Junior Logistics Specialist – Europe** to strengthen our European Logistics team. The position will be based in Poland and will work closely with the Head of Logistics, United Imaging Healthcare Europe, supporting logistics operations across Central and Eastern Europe while gradually developing a broader understanding of United Imaging’s end-to-end European logistics network. ### **About the Role** United Imaging’s European logistics operation covers the complete equipment delivery process — from **factory pick-up in China, China export, international transportation and European customs clearance, through warehousing and final delivery to the customer**. As a Junior Logistics Specialist, you will initially focus on the daily execution and coordination of logistics activities for the **Central and Eastern European region**, while supporting European-wide logistics processes, documentation and standardization. This is a hands-on operational role. You will work closely with Project Management, Order Management, Finance, Service, Headquarters Supply Chain, freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouses and local transportation partners. Over time, you will be expected to take ownership of increasingly complex logistics activities and internal processes, allowing senior Logistics management to focus more on the further development of United Imaging’s logistics network in Western Europe. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Coordinate day-to-day logistics activities for medical imaging equipment and related materials across Central and Eastern Europe. * Support the complete logistics process from factory readiness and shipment planning through final customer delivery. * Coordinate factory pick-up and export arrangements with Headquarters Supply Chain and logistics teams in China. * Follow international transportation by road, rail, sea or air and maintain clear shipment visibility. * Coordinate European import and customs clearance activities with freight forwarders and customs brokers. * Support warehousing activities including inbound, storage, outbound and final delivery preparation. * Coordinate final-mile delivery of large medical imaging equipment to hospitals and customer sites. * Communicate closely with local transportation providers and drivers, particularly in Poland and the CEE region. * Maintain regular communication with Project Management and other internal stakeholders regarding shipment status, delivery schedules and potential risks. * Identify logistics risks or delays early and escalate them proactively. ### **Documentation & Process Control** * Prepare, review and maintain logistics documentation including: * + CMR consignment notes + Commercial invoices + Packing lists + Proof of Delivery documentation + Customs and import/export documentation * Ensure customer-signed CMR and other required delivery documentation are collected, properly archived and communicated internally. * Support documentation required for internal delivery confirmation and revenue recognition processes. * Maintain structured shipment trackers and regular logistics status reporting. * Support project-level logistics cost tracking and invoice verification. * Follow the principle of clear project-level cost allocation and proper linkage between logistics services, invoices and order numbers. * Maintain accurate records in Excel and relevant internal systems. ### **Process Improvement & Standardization** * Support the development and implementation of standardized European logistics processes. * Help maintain and improve SOPs, templates, shipment trackers and documentation standards. * Support the standardization of CMR, Proof of Delivery and logistics documentation across European markets. * Assist with the identification of recurring operational issues and propose practical process improvements. * Support the development of shipment visibility and early-risk-escalation mechanisms. * Work with senior Logistics management to improve cost transparency and logistics invoice control. ### **Supplier, Warehouse & Delivery Coordination** * Support coordination and performance follow-up with freight forwarders, warehouses, trucking companies and specialized medical-equipment delivery providers. * Support supplier qualification and operational evaluation when required. * Assist with warehouse and transportation standards across different European countries. * Support the development of reliable local logistics networks as United Imaging expands its direct business in Europe. * Communicate effectively with both international suppliers and local operational teams, including drivers and warehouse personnel. **Your Profile** ---------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade, Business or a related field. * **1–3 years of practical experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, transportation or a similar operational role.** * Fluent written and spoken **English**. * Polish language skills are preferred. * Strong practical working experience with **Microsoft Excel and Word**. * Comfortable creating and maintaining shipment trackers, reports and operational documentation. * Basic knowledge of international road transportation and **CMR documentation**. * Basic understanding of: * + Commercial invoices + Packing lists + Proof of Delivery + Customs clearance + Import/export processes + Incoterms * Experience communicating with freight forwarders, trucking companies, warehouses or customs brokers is preferred. * Strong attention to detail, particularly regarding documentation, dates, shipment information and invoices. * Strong organizational and follow-up skills. * Able to manage multiple shipments and operational priorities simultaneously. * Able to communicate clearly with both office-based colleagues and operational personnel such as drivers and warehouse teams. * Fast learner with a strong sense of ownership. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- Experience or knowledge in the following areas would be an advantage, but is not mandatory: * Medical device logistics. * High-value or large capital equipment transportation. * Specialized hospital delivery. * European road transportation. * International sea or rail transportation from China to Europe. * Customs procedures for medical equipment. * SAP or other ERP systems. * Basic understanding of **MRI logistics and handling requirements**. * Awareness of topics such as: * + MRI magnet handling + Cold magnet storage + Helium monitoring + Power requirements during transportation or storage + Special handling requirements for sensitive medical equipment **What We Look For** -------------------- We are looking for someone who: * Is practical and execution-oriented. * Learns new processes quickly. * Takes responsibility for following tasks through to completion. * Pays close attention to documentation and operational details. * Is comfortable working with both data and people. * Does not simply forward information, but actively follows up and helps solve problems. * Can communicate confidently with drivers, logistics suppliers and international colleagues. * Remains organized when several projects are moving at the same time. * Is interested in developing from daily logistics execution into broader European logistics management. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Direct coaching and mentoring from the **Head of Logistics, United Imaging Healthcare Europe**. * Hands-on involvement in end-to-end European logistics projects. * Exposure to the entire logistics chain from China factory pick-up to European customer delivery. * Experience in customs, transportation, warehousing and specialized medical-equipment delivery. * Opportunity to work across multiple European countries and functions. * Participation in the development and standardization of United Imaging’s European logistics processes. * Exposure to complex MRI and other high-value medical-equipment logistics. * A clear development path toward broader European logistics and supply chain responsibilities.

title: Application Analyst
description: ***Posting Type*** Remote ***Job Overview*** WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO The Application Analyst is the entry point into Relativity's technical career ladder for Product Support — a highly technical, platform-troubleshooting role, not a call-center position. Application Analysts diagnose and resolve incidents on the RelativityOne / Relativity Server platform for a mix of technical and non-technical customers, working within an assigned product vertical (e.g., Core Review, Search & Analytics, Processing & Imaging, Data Transfer, Platform & Infrastructure). ABOUT THE ROLE This role is designed for someone early in a SaaS technical-support career who is building foundational skills in SQL, Windows/networking fundamentals, and the Relativity platform itself, while developing the judgment to know when to resolve independently and when to escalate. Application Analysts work high ticket volume with close adherence to documented procedures and Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and rely heavily on the team's knowledgebase, swarming channels, and senior technicians for guidance on anything outside known patterns. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **WHAT YOU’LL DO** **Technical Troubleshooting & Support** * Triage, diagnose, and resolve incoming incidents and service requests logged in Salesforce, following documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and knowledgebase (KB) articles. * Run basic SQL queries against Relativity databases to investigate and confirm root cause for common issues (e.g., workspace configuration, permissions, saved searches, imaging/processing errors). * Recognize when an issue falls outside known patterns and initiate a swarm with teammates or a specialist before escalating further. * Support day-one troubleshooting of RelativityOne AI applications (e.g., aiR for Review, aiR Assist, aiR for Case Strategy) at a foundational level, partnering with senior teammates on anything beyond basic configuration questions. **AI-Enabled Support Workflow** * **[AI]** Utilize AI-assisted tools throughout the support workflow (triage, research, drafting responses) to resolve tickets faster and more accurately, continuously adapting as new tools and capabilities are introduced. **Customer Interaction & Advocacy** * Respond to client questions, problems, and work requests via phone, email, and ticketing within SLA. * Deliver clear, empathetic, and accurate communication to a mix of technical and non-technical customers, translating platform behavior into plain language. * Take the initiative to share best practices on the use of Relativity when interacting with customers. **Product, Vertical & Platform Expertise** * Build foundational knowledge of the Relativity platform and the assigned product vertical; actively pursue RelativityOne Certified Professional and RelativityOne Review Professional certifications. * Stay current on new Relativity features and releases relevant to the assigned vertical, including newly supported AI applications. **Collaboration, Escalation & Swarming** * Partner with senior-level teammates as needed to troubleshoot and resolve customer incidents, using swarming as the first line of support before escalating. Follow the team's escalation path (vertical specialist * engineering / DB Services / Site Services, as applicable) and Urgent Transition (UT) process for issues that must move between shifts or regions. * Contribute to and follow Knowledge-Centered Support (KCS) practices, including flagging gaps in existing KB articles. **Process, Documentation & Quality** * Create, categorize, update, escalate, transition, and resolve tickets in Salesforce with accurate documentation to support historical reporting. * Maintain close attention to detail when coding and documenting tickets to ensure accurate reporting and historical data integrity. * Track time daily and monitor assigned open tickets, updating customers on a timely basis. **Metrics & Continuous Improvement** * Meet identified goals with respect to Customer Support KPIs (e.g., SLA adherence, first response time, quality). Accept feedback from peers, Shift Leads, and management, and demonstrably apply it to improve technical accuracy and communication. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** **Required** * Prior customer support experience; SaaS or technology environment strongly preferred. * Demonstrated aptitude for, or early experience with, SQL, Windows platforms, and troubleshooting technical issues — willingness to rapidly build depth in these areas is essential. * Client-focused mindset with the ability to understand and manage customer expectations under SLA pressure. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. * Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-ticket-volume technical environment with defined procedures. Ability to travel up to 10% of the time for training or customer engagements, as needed. Relativity is a diverse workplace with different skills and life experiences—and we love and celebrate those differences. We believe that employees are happiest when they're empowered to be their full, authentic selves, regardless how you identify. **Benefit Highlights:** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans Parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers Flexible work arrangements Two, week-long company breaks per year Additional time off Long-term incentive program Training investment program All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: 82 000 and 122 000PLN The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Application Management, Database Management, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Structured Query Language (SQL), System Implementations, Systems Analysis, Technical Support

description: **Company Description** At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We own the B2B funnel across all our markets: lead generation, MQL quality and reachability, and the hand-off to Sales. We believe AI will change how B2B marketing works, and we want to lead that change, not follow it. That means testing new AI tools, agents and automations fast, keeping what moves the funnel, and turning it into the standard way every marketing team at Docplanner works. We work the way Docplanner works: results over tasks, lean and hands-on, learning by doing. **Job Description** As **AI Project Manager** in Growth Marketing B2B, **you find, test and launch the AI tools and solutions that make our whole marketing team faster and more effective**. You own each project end to end: from the first idea or use case to a setup that markets run on their own and that shows up in the business numbers. You are accountable for the outcome, not for tracking tasks. A project is done when it is adopted and delivers results at scale, not when the tool goes live. No two projects are the same. One week you're piloting an AI calling bot with two markets; the next you're building an agent that automates campaign reporting, or rolling out a new AI workflow to every marketer. You know the AI landscape well enough to pick the right tool for the problem, you're hands-on enough to set it up yourself, and you're honest enough to stop what doesn't work. **How will you make an impact?** You will run a portfolio of AI experiments, rollouts and internal enablement projects where marketing, sales and automation meet. Examples: * **Conversational WhatsApp bot.** Test new use cases, find the ones that bring business results, and turn them into a standard setup every market can launch and run on its own. * **MQL reachability with AI.** Pilot the WhatsApp bot and an AI calling bot to contact more leads, faster. Prove the impact on contact rate and pipeline, then scale what works. * **AI agents and automations for marketers.** Automate repetitive work such as campaign reporting, lead enrichment and content localisation with agents and no-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier). * **AI tool scouting and adoption.** Evaluate new AI tools for the marketing team, run the business case and security review with IT, and roll out the winners with training and clear guidelines. Every project follows the same path: use case hypothesis pilot measured result playbook and setup for markets adoption. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the outcome.** Set the goal, KPIs, plan, budget and timeline for each AI project, and answer for the result. * **Find the right problems for AI.** Spot where marketers lose time or where the funnel leaks, and turn those into AI use cases with a clear business case. * **Test before you scale.** Turn use cases into hypotheses with success criteria, run pilots with local teams, and decide on data whether to scale, iterate or stop. * **Build hands-on.** Configure tools, write and test prompts, build agents and automations, and connect them to our stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, WhatsApp). Unblock issues yourself and escalate early when you can't. * **Choose tools wisely.** Scout and compare AI vendors, run the evaluation with IT, Legal and Security (data privacy, GDPR), and negotiate what we need. * **Make it work for markets.** Build the playbooks, prompt libraries, training and handover that let every market adopt proven solutions on their own. * **Raise the AI level of the whole team.** Share what works, run demos and enablement sessions, and help marketers use AI in their daily work. * **Report in business terms.** Share results (MQLs, contact rate, meetings booked, conversion, hours saved) and what we learned, so the next project goes faster. **Qualifications** **What will help you thrive?** * 3+ years managing projects in marketing, growth, marketing operations or a similar commercial area, with at least 1 year focused on AI or automation projects. * AI projects you owned that delivered measurable results, and you know the numbers. * Deep, daily, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) to research, analyse, write and automate, and you can show us how. * Experience building AI agents or automations yourself with no-code or low-code tools (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier), including APIs and webhooks. * A solid grasp of how LLMs work: prompting, their limits and risks (hallucinations, data privacy), and how to evaluate output quality. * Strong analytical skills: you set KPIs, read data and make decisions from it. * Experience running pilots and scaling them across teams, markets or regions. * You act without waiting for instructions and bring structure where there isn't any. * You challenge assumptions, including the hype: you know when AI is the answer and when it isn't. * You work well with many stakeholders, including senior ones, and get things done without formal authority. * Fluent English. **What we offer** ----------------- * **Real ownership:** AI projects that are yours, with visible impact on how marketing works across all our markets. * **New technology first:** work with conversational AI, agents and automation before they become standard, with the budget to test them. * **A small, fast team** that values results over process and learning over being right. * **Direct exposure** to marketing, sales and commercial leadership. **What to Expect from Our Hiring Process** We like to keep things transparent and efficient! title: Customer Support Specialist with German
description: **About SINGU** At **SINGU**, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Throughout the day, you support users via **email, phone, and ticketing systems**, translating their issues into **calm guidance and practical next steps**. You also help the community grow by assisting with **onboarding and training of new users**, making their first steps feel easy and confident. You’ll guide customers through the switch end to end: you **run trainings and webinars**, **answer their questions** along the way, and **proactively spot and solve problems** before they turn into blockers – so every customer lands on the new platform confident and ready to go. **This is a hybrid position – 2-3 days from the office (Cracow or Warsaw) per week.** **What You'll Bring to the Team** --------------------------------- * **Fluent in both German and English** (spoken & written) — **mandatory**: you'll support users confidently in both languages, making complex topics feel **trainings, webinars, or onboarding sessions** is a big plus – you enjoy walking people through new tools and making change feel easy. * Ability to work **independently, structured, and with high attention to detail**: you're organized, reliable, and you don't let small things slip through the cracks. * **Basic understanding of databases, APIs, or ticketing systems** is a plus: you don't need to be a developer, but you're comfortable around technical concepts and tools. * **Hands-on experience with Intercom, Zoho, or Jira** is a plus: these are the tools you’ll use every day, so knowing your way around them helps you hit the ground running. * Experience in **Facility Management or SaaS environments** is an advantage, but not required: if you know the space, great — if not, your **curiosity and learning speed** matter most. **What we offer** ----------------- * **Competitive salary** – depending on your experience, we offer 8 300 – 11 200 PLN gross CoE, or 10 000 – 13 500 PLN net b2b. * **Flexible, hybrid working:** combine on-site days in our office with home office * **A collaborative, no-micromanagement culture with honest, open feedback** – we work as equals, share what didn’t go well, and improve together. * **Part of a fast-scaling international group** – redefining how real estate and maintenance are managed across Europe * **Open company culture** with **flat hierarchies** at Europe’s **fastest-growing CAFM company** * Individual **training and development** opportunities * Regular **team events** & **company events** If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft) * Where a candidate sits within the band is determined by assessed experience against the grade criteria, depth in the required stack (Snowflake, dbt, Power BI/DAX) and relevant financial-services exposure. description: **Company Description** At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es **Why join us?** Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success. **About the team** ------------------ Growth Marketing B2B brings doctors and clinics to Docplanner and turns them into customers. We own the B2B funnel across all our markets: lead generation, MQL quality and reachability, and the hand-off to Sales. We believe AI will change how B2B marketing works, and we want to lead that change, not follow it. That means testing new AI tools, agents and automations fast, keeping what moves the funnel, and turning it into the standard way every marketing team at Docplanner works. We work the way Docplanner works: results over tasks, lean and hands-on, learning by doing. **Job Description** As **AI Project Manager** in Growth Marketing B2B, **you find, test and launch the AI tools and solutions that make our whole marketing team faster and more effective**. You own each project end to end: from the first idea or use case to a setup that markets run on their own and that shows up in the business numbers. You are accountable for the outcome, not for tracking tasks. A project is done when it is adopted and delivers results at scale, not when the tool goes live. No two projects are the same. One week you're piloting an AI calling bot with two markets; the next you're building an agent that automates campaign reporting, or rolling out a new AI workflow to every marketer. You know the AI landscape well enough to pick the right tool for the problem, you're hands-on enough to set it up yourself, and you're honest enough to stop what doesn't work. **How will you make an impact?** You will run a portfolio of AI experiments, rollouts and internal enablement projects where marketing, sales and automation meet. Examples: * **Conversational WhatsApp bot.** Test new use cases, find the ones that bring business results, and turn them into a standard setup every market can launch and run on its own. * **MQL reachability with AI.** Pilot the WhatsApp bot and an AI calling bot to contact more leads, faster. Prove the impact on contact rate and pipeline, then scale what works. * **AI agents and automations for marketers.** Automate repetitive work such as campaign reporting, lead enrichment and content localisation with agents and no-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier). * **AI tool scouting and adoption.** Evaluate new AI tools for the marketing team, run the business case and security review with IT, and roll out the winners with training and clear guidelines. Every project follows the same path: use case hypothesis pilot measured result playbook and setup for markets adoption. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the outcome.** Set the goal, KPIs, plan, budget and timeline for each AI project, and answer for the result. * **Find the right problems for AI.** Spot where marketers lose time or where the funnel leaks, and turn those into AI use cases with a clear business case. * **Test before you scale.** Turn use cases into hypotheses with success criteria, run pilots with local teams, and decide on data whether to scale, iterate or stop. * **Build hands-on.** Configure tools, write and test prompts, build agents and automations, and connect them to our stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, WhatsApp). Unblock issues yourself and escalate early when you can't. * **Choose tools wisely.** Scout and compare AI vendors, run the evaluation with IT, Legal and Security (data privacy, GDPR), and negotiate what we need. * **Make it work for markets.** Build the playbooks, prompt libraries, training and handover that let every market adopt proven solutions on their own. * **Raise the AI level of the whole team.** Share what works, run demos and enablement sessions, and help marketers use AI in their daily work. * **Report in business terms.** Share results (MQLs, contact rate, meetings booked, conversion, hours saved) and what we learned, so the next project goes faster. **Qualifications** **What will help you thrive?** * 3+ years managing projects in marketing, growth, marketing operations or a similar commercial area, with at least 1 year focused on AI or automation projects. * AI projects you owned that delivered measurable results, and you know the numbers. * Deep, daily, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) to research, analyse, write and automate, and you can show us how. * Experience building AI agents or automations yourself with no-code or low-code tools (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier), including APIs and webhooks. * A solid grasp of how LLMs work: prompting, their limits and risks (hallucinations, data privacy), and how to evaluate output quality. * Strong analytical skills: you set KPIs, read data and make decisions from it. * Experience running pilots and scaling them across teams, markets or regions. * You act without waiting for instructions and bring structure where there isn't any. * You challenge assumptions, including the hype: you know when AI is the answer and when it isn't. * You work well with many stakeholders, including senior ones, and get things done without formal authority. * Fluent English. **What we offer** ----------------- * **Real ownership:** AI projects that are yours, with visible impact on how marketing works across all our markets. * **New technology first:** work with conversational AI, agents and automation before they become standard, with the budget to test them. * **A small, fast team** that values results over process and learning over being right. * **Direct exposure** to marketing, sales and commercial leadership. **What to Expect from Our Hiring Process** We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role): **Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. **Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with **Joanna Zukowska** and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. **Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings. **Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another stakeholder or peer from our Global Team. **References & Offer!** **Why You’ll Love It Here** **Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to: * Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters. * Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered. * Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. **Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. **Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects. **A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. **Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. *Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role. **What We Believe In** At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do: **Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact. **Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes. **Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity. **Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust. **Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job. description: **Overview** ------------ Smartling was founded 16 years ago to make localization and translation seamless. Today, Smartling is profitable and backed by Vitruvian Partners, a global technology-focused investment firm, supporting company growth and expanding our market share and leadership position. We are the only cloud-based, AI-enabled translation platform that combines a Neural Machine Translation Hub and professional language services, empowering teams to collaborate in real-time to create experiences customers love. Smartling is looking for a creative and passionate Senior Software Engineer to work remotely and build and support highly-scalable services that deliver best-in-class experiences for our clients. You will be working on a multi-disciplinary team, contributing to technical architecture decisions, and building robust, enterprise-grade systems. You will have the opportunity to work across the full technology stack and deliver high-impact results for the company. You will be joining an existing team developing and maintaining Smartling's translation management application that allows our clients and professional translators to manage the localization process for their websites and documents in an agile fashion. Our Engineering Processes & Beliefs: * AI-first development - AI agents write all new code, engineers own the design, review, and results * TDD - Test Driven Development * Continuous Deployment - multiple times daily * SOA - Service Oriented Architecture and APIs * Full test automation - we have no QA team * DevOps is not a team, it is a culture **You Will** ------------ * Own features end to end, from clarifying the problem to releasing in production * Work across repositories and technologies (Java, Node, React, and others) delivering all new code through AI agents, with Claude Code as your main tool * Take responsibility for the quality of everything you ship, including work produced by AI agents * Work with colleagues, product managers, and CSMs to clarify scope, trade-offs, and client needs * Cover changes with automated tests and take them through the delivery pipeline * Judge your work by value delivered to clients and the company, not by lines changed or tickets closed **You Have** ------------ * Senior engineering experience, and either full-stack skills or readiness to become full-stack * Working proficiency in at least one backend language (Java, Kotlin, or Node) and willingness to work in the others * Solid grasp of software architecture, including service-oriented architecture * Understanding of events, message buses, and asynchronous processing * Relational database background, including schema design, indexes * Computer science fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, and runtime basics such as garbage collection * Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and the judgment to review what they produce * Engineering discipline. You can design, test, and explain every change you ship, including code written by an agent. * Broad knowledge across the stack rather than deep specialization in one tool * Fluent written and spoken English * Ability to communicate clearly with engineers and non-technical colleagues * BS+ degree in computer science or equivalent experience * A home office setup conducive for working remotely, and the ability to work effectively as a remote team member\* **Preferred but not required** ------------------------------ * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React * Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and large data sets * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) * Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) **You Are** ----------- * Curious. You learn new tools and areas quickly. * Value-driven. You choose the work that matters most to clients. * Detail-oriented. You verify what an agent produces before you ship it. * A team player. You work well with peers, product, and client-facing colleagues. * An individual contributor. You want to build and ship, not to manage people. **You Will Enjoy** ------------------ * Freedom - we are remote first * Growth - an opportunity to learn and advance your career * Modern tooling - Claude Code is a core part of your daily workflow * Culture - an energetic, value-driven, and fun culture and team spirit Smartling is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, skills, and experiences. * *To work from home, you must have a strong internet connection, a quiet space, and a professional (distraction and clutter-free) background.*

description: **Senior Data Engineer —** **Kraków** **Location:** Kraków( onsite hybrid) · **Team:** Data Platform · **Reports to:** Head of Tech **About EC Markets and the role** EC Markets is an FCA-regulated FX and CFD brokerage with offices in London, Cyprus and Dubai. We are building a next-generation data platform to power trading, operational and marketing intelligence, and are growing our Sofia Data Platform team as part of that investment. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the evolution of our Snowflake-based Data Lakehouse and establish a modern data ecosystem that supports advanced analytics, regulatory reporting and decision-making across the business. This is a high-impact role for someone with a track record of architecting and implementing scalable data platforms — ideally in financial or trading environments — who can think end-to-end, from ingestion through to management-information dashboards. **What you will be doing** **Architecture & development** * Take ownership of a Snowflake-centric Data Lakehouse integrating structured, semi-structured and unstructured data. * Develop and support robust ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest and transform data from multiple internal systems (trading, CRM, finance, risk) and external APIs. * Implement data models, schemas and transformation frameworks optimised for analytical and regulatory use cases. * Apply best practices in data versioning, orchestration and automation using modern data engineering tools. * Ensure scalability, data lineage and governance across the data lifecycle. **Reporting & semantic modelling** * Build and own semantic models on top of Snowflake (DirectQuery and Import) using DAX, calculation groups, RLS/OLS and incremental refresh. * Develop operational reports, dashboards and data extracts for Trading, Finance, Marketing, Compliance and Operations. **Data governance & quality** * Maintain high data integrity, privacy and security aligned with FCA and GDPR requirements. * Monitor and optimise query performance and storage efficiency. **Cross-functional collaboration** * Partner with business units to capture data requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. * Support regulatory, management and operational reporting requirements through structured data models. **What you will bring (non-negotiable)** * Experience in financial services, trading or fintech environments. * Proven experience designing and delivering a DWH or Delta Lakehouse using Snowflake. * Expert-level SQL and data modelling expertise (star/snowflake schemas, dimensional modelling). * At least 2 years writing dbt models in production. Comfortable with sources, snapshots, tests, macros, exposures and the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) pattern. * At least 3 years building production Power BI on enterprise warehouses. Expert DAX (time intelligence, variables, virtual relationships, calculation groups), Power Query / M, Tabular Editor, DAX Studio. * Strong SQL on Snowflake, with a working understanding of warehouse sizing, clustering, query profiles and the cost levers that matter. * Familiarity with orchestration and transformation frameworks. * Hands-on experience with data analysis, visualisation and operational reporting tools. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable data architecture. **Nice to have** * Scripting in Python or another modern scripting language. * Experience with AWS (ECS, S3, IAM), Terraform, Git / GitHub Actions. * Power BI Embedded, Microsoft Fabric, or a credible point of view on when not to use them. * Exposure to Microsoft Fabric Direct Lake, Snowflake Cortex, the Claude.ai connector or other AI-on-warehouse patterns. **Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 5–8 years of hands-on experience in data engineering and/or analytics engineering. **Compensation & benefits** In line with Directive (EU) 2023/970 on pay transparency, we publish the full starting pay package for this role up front. * Base salary (gross, annual) * EUR 60,000 – 65,500 * Annual performance bonus * Eligible for an annual company performance bonus under the Group bonus scheme; details shared at offer stage (Regional component) * Pension & social security * Employer contributions in line with statutory requirements * Supplementary health insurance * Annual leave 20 working days plus public holidays * Equipment & learning * Company-provided hardware; annual learning & certification budget (incl. Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft) * Where a candidate sits within the band is determined by assessed experience against the grade criteria, depth in the required stack (Snowflake, dbt, Power BI/DAX) and relevant financial-services exposure. The same criteria are applied to any later pay progression. **How we hire** Our recruitment process is aligned with Directive (EU) 2023/970 on pay transparency and equal pay, and with the draft Bulgarian transposition law currently before the National Assembly: * **Transparent pay from the start.** The salary band, bonus mechanic and benefits above apply from the first conversation. We will not negotiate below the published band on the basis of a candidate's current or previous pay. * **No salary-history questions.** We will not ask you about your current or previous salary at any stage, and our application form does not collect it. You are not required to disclose it to be considered. * **Gender-neutral process.** The job title and this description are gender-neutral and we welcome applications from candidates of all genders and backgrounds. Interview panels are balanced wherever practicable. * **Objective, written criteria.** Shortlisting, interview scoring and the final pay offer within the band are made against pre-defined, written criteria (grade framework, technical scorecard, behavioural rubric). The same criteria apply to later pay progression and are available on request. * **Right to information once hired.** You will have the right to request, in writing, information on your individual pay level and on the average pay levels for workers performing the same work or work of equal value, broken down by sex, in line with Art. 7 of the Directive. **Process at a glance:** CV screen recruiter conversation (30 min, incl. salary disclosure) technical interview with the Head of Data (60 min) practical exercise (take-home or live, your choice) final interview with a cross-functional panel offer. Typical end-to-end timeline: 3–4 weeks. Reasonable adjustments available at any stage — just let us know. **Equal opportunities and how to apply** EC Markets is an equal-opportunities employer. We make hiring decisions on the basis of skills, experience and demonstrated potential, and do not discriminate on the grounds of sex, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital or civil-partnership status, pregnancy or parental status, or trade-union membership. Please do **not** include your current or previous salary, we will not use it in our decision and are not permitted to request it. Any personal data you share will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice and the GDPR. Questions about the role, the salary band or reasonable adjustments: contact the People Team at the same address.

description: **About the Opportunity** Expansion International is partnering with our client, a healthcare interpreting and language services provider, to build out a team of Medical Video Remote Interpreters across multiple languages, including Ukrainian. This is a newly scaling programme, so we are recruiting a number of interpreters as our client grows its remote interpreting capacity across the US healthcare system. The role sits fully remote and connects healthcare professionals with patients who are more comfortable communicating in a language other than English, primarily through video, with occasional over-the-phone sessions. This is a genuine route into a career in medical interpreting. Full training is provided, and previous professional interpreting experience is a bonus rather than a requirement, provided you can demonstrate strong bilingual fluency and a real understanding of what interpreting involves. **The Role** As a Medical Video Remote Interpreter, you will facilitate clear, accurate communication between English speaking healthcare providers and Ukrainian speaking patients, without adding, omitting, or changing the meaning of what is said. Sessions take place on camera, so a professional presence and a dedicated, quiet workspace are essential. This is a client facing role. You will interact directly with patients and healthcare professionals in sensitive, and sometimes high pressure, medical situations, so composure, confidentiality, and cultural sensitivity matter as much as language skill. Candidates go through a structured evaluation process (resume review, phone interview, recorded prescreen, a medical interpreting proficiency assessment, and a final interview), and successful candidates complete a foundations training programme before starting live sessions. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide accurate, complete, and respectful video interpreting between English and Ukrainian, with occasional over-the-phone sessions. * Facilitate communication faithfully, without adding, omitting, or altering the speakers' meaning. * Follow professional interpreter ethics, standards of practice, and company procedures. * Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable healthcare privacy requirements. * Demonstrate cultural responsiveness and respect for differing backgrounds, communication styles, and patient preferences. * Maintain professional conduct before, during, and after each session, and use sound judgement around interpreter role boundaries. * Adapt to evolving technology, workflows, and service requirements. * Take part in required training, coaching, and quality related activities. **Required Skills & Experience** * Fluent, professional level verbal communication in both English and Ukrainian. * A genuine understanding of what medical interpreting involves. This can come from informal experience, such as interpreting for family members, rather than formal employment. * Ability to interpret medical information accurately and completely in both languages. * Willingness to complete a medical interpreting proficiency assessment as part of the selection process. * Cultural responsiveness and comfort working within the US healthcare context. * Strong professional reliability and sound judgement, with a customer service mindset. * Comfort working with video conferencing platforms and adapting to new remote technology. * Able to pass background and drug screening. * A dedicated home workspace reserved for this role: a private, distraction-free room with a door that locks, where no one else can see your screen while you work, and wired high speed internet (no Wi-Fi, hotspot, satellite, or DSL).
