title: HR Administration Specialist (Warsaw)
description: ##### **About Fresha** Fresha is the **leading AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry,** giving businesses everything they need to run smarter, grow faster and build stronger client relationships. In May 2026, Fresha secured an **$80M growth investment from KKR at a valuation of $1B**, officially reaching unicorn status and bringing total funding raised to $285M. Already profitable, Fresha is using this investment to accelerate global expansion and drive the next generation of AI and product innovation. Today, Fresha operates at global scale, with offices across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. Our platform is trusted by **130,000+ beauty and wellness businesses across 120 countries**, with more than **1.5 billion appointments booked** to date. Our mission is simple: **help beauty and wellness businesses grow by giving them the technology they need to attract clients, manage their operations and run their business in one place.** We’re continuing to scale rapidly across markets, teams and products, making this an exciting time to join us. ##### **Role Overview** **HR Administration Specialist | Warsaw, PL | Office-based 4 days per week | 7,000 - 10,000 gross PLN** Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional HR Administration Specialist to come and join our global business. Reporting directly to the Payroll & HR Admin Team Lead, and working collaboratively with the wider team and external partners, you will be responsible for managing HR administrative tasks, maintaining accurate employee records, and supporting the end-to-end employee lifecycle for our global workforce. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge and wants to make an impact. To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from the office four days per week, with the flexibility to work remotely one day each week. ##### **What You'll Do** * **Global HRIS & Data Management** – Maintain and update our HR system (HiBob) and Employer of Record (EOR) platform ensuring all data regarding new joiners and existing employees is accurate across all regions. * **Documentation Management** – Oversee various global HR administration tasks, including preparing, sending, and drafting employees' and contractors’ agreements, annexes, and side agreements for different locations, while ensuring all essential HR paperwork is completed and organized. * **Lifecycle Changes** – Process internal changes for our global team, including salary increases, promotions, and transfers across our international entities. * **Process Automation** - Actively work on automating workflows within the HRIS to streamline administrative tasks and improve the efficiency of the global employee lifecycle. * **Global Mobility** – Administer visa and work permit processes, coordinating with external partners to support our international workforce. * **Payroll & Employee Support** – Provide essential support to the payroll team and act as a point of contact for global employee queries. This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you may be required to deliver. ##### **What We're Looking For** * Minimum 1-2 years of experience working in HR, preferably in an international environment. * Proficiency in English at a minimum B2 level; knowledge of additional languages is an advantage. * Experience in HR systems (HiBob), Google Sheets/Excel, and data management tools is a strong plus. * Proactive mindset with a focus on process improvement and automation. * Strong organizational skills and keen attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize tasks and apply logical thinking in a fast-paced environment. * Commitment to providing a seamless and supportive experience for employees across the global lifecycle. * Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across different regions. * Understanding of data confidentiality and compliance with local regulations and labor laws. At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role. ##### **Your Opportunity at Fresha** * **Make an impact at scale:** Support employees across multiple markets and contribute to a seamless experience throughout the employee lifecycle. * **Take ownership:** Own HR administration and payroll processes, identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, and help drive automation and continuous improvement. * **Be part of a growing international environment:** Partner with colleagues, stakeholders and external providers across different countries, cultures and timezones. * **Be close to the action:** Join a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your work directly contributes to how we scale our people operations. * **Grow with Fresha**: Develop your HR and payroll expertise while gaining broad exposure to international HR operations, systems, processes and compliance. There are endless growth and progression opportunities as the team continues to grow! ##### **Inclusive workforce** At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable. We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

title: Commercial Counsel Europe
description: **About The Role** ------------------ Kerry is seeking an experienced and commercially minded lawyer to support Procurement and Supply Chain contracting across Europe. In addition, this role will support Kerry's Biotechnology business in Europe, involving intellectual property, commercial and regulatory work. The **Commercial Counsel, Europe** will work closely with the General Counsel (Europe) and other Senior Commercial Counsels on the Europe Legal Team and be a trusted day-to-day legal partner to relevant business and functional teams, managing an assigned portfolio from instruction through negotiation and execution. The successful candidate will set objectives for their assigned portfolio, execute tactical legal plans, deliver operational results, resolve complex contracting issues where precedent may be limited, and contribute to process improvement. The role is expected to operate independently on matters within agreed parameters, while seeking manager support on material, novel, high-risk or strategically significant matters. **Please note**: Occasional travel within Europe may be required. **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ **Procurement and Supply Chain Contracts** ------------------------------------------ * Draft, review, negotiate and advise on procurement, logistics and supply chain agreements, including for goods and services, technology, equipment purchase, outsourcing (including third-party manufacturing), warehousing, transport, energy, professional services, NDAs and other supplier arrangements. * Take ownership of an assigned contract portfolio, progressing matters efficiently from initial instruction through negotiation, approval and execution. * Provide practical, commercial and risk-based advice on key contractual issues such as liability, indemnities, warranties, security of supply, termination, compliance and intellectual property protection. * Provide legal support on pre-litigation contractual disputes and advise on commercial resolutions. * Partner with Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Quality, Regulatory, Digital and other stakeholders on appropriate risk allocation and workable commercial outcomes. **Biotechnology Contractual and Regulatory Support** ---------------------------------------------------- * Support biotechnology-related commercial arrangements and intellectual property arrangements, including supply, third-party manufacturing, development, collaboration, licensing, material or strain transfer, research services, quality, manufacturing and confidentiality agreements. * Work with commercial, scientific, R&D, quality, regulatory and operational stakeholders to support the development, manufacture, supply and commercialisation of biotechnology products and technologies. * Provide first-line support on contractual and regulatory questions within experience and delegated scope, coordinating with specialist colleagues or external counsel where required. * Translate relevant regulatory requirements and developments into concise, practical guidance and contracting actions for the business. **General Counsel (Europe) Support** ------------------------------------ * Work closely with the General Counsel (Europe) on strategic matters for the European business. * Support Kerry's Speak Up initiative in Europe within an agreed Speak Up governance framework and under the direction of the General Counsel (Europe) and the Senior Employment Counsel (Europe). * Support the General Counsel (Europe) on selected cross-functional, governance, regulatory and strategic legal matters, including preparation of briefings and coordination of follow-up actions. * Support the development of Kerry templates, playbooks, approved positions and contract lifecycle management tools. * Deliver targeted training and know-how to business stakeholders and share learning across the Europe Legal Team. * Support effective matter management, reporting and use of data to improve legal service delivery. **Qualifications & Experience** ------------------------------- * Qualified lawyer in a European jurisdiction with 3-5 years PQE and entitled to practise or provide in-house legal services as required in the relevant location. * Fluent written and spoken English. Fluency in a second European language is desirable. * Relevant post-qualification experience in commercial contracting, typically gained in-house and/or in a large international law firm, sufficient to manage an appropriate portfolio with a meaningful degree of independence. * Demonstrable experience in procurement, supply chain and commercial agreements. * Experience supporting licensing, collaboration, development, technology or commercialisation agreements. * Ability to manage complex negotiations and advise stakeholders independently within agreed parameters. * In-house experience in a multinational organisation, particularly in food, ingredients, biotechnology, manufacturing or FMCG, is preferred. **Skills & Attributes** ----------------------- * Strong drafting, negotiation and contract risk-assessment skills, with the ability to translate legal issues into clear and workable business solutions. * Commercially pragmatic and able to balance growth, speed, value and legal risk. * Able to organise and prioritise a varied workload, meet business timelines and maintain appropriate records, workload management and reporting discipline. * Confident stakeholder manager who collaborates effectively across functions, cultures and jurisdictions. * Sound judgement, integrity and discretion, with an appropriate understanding of when to decide, when to consult and when to escalate. * Comfortable working in a matrixed international organisation and using contract lifecycle management and other legal technology tools. **About Kerry** --------------- Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment. **Get in touch today!** ----------------------- In Kerry we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles, and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally. description: Where: 100% Remote Type: Full-time, via our employer of record ### **About MarketFully Group** We've combined four established companies - MotionPoint, Key Content, GetGloby, and Social Element - into one company: MarketFully. comfortable taking a business goal from a non-technical stakeholder and independently determining the right Salesforce architecture and build approach, without step-by-step technical direction * Excellent written and spoken English, with proven experience leading discovery conversations directly with US-based business stakeholders - asking probing questions, surfacing unstated requirements, and pushing back on scope when needed * A pragmatic, user-first mindset with a track record of delivering high-impact solutions without over-engineering #### **Why join us** * Help improve the tools and processes that support a globally focused business * Work with colleagues across teams and contribute to practical, high-impact improvements * Be part of a customer-first organisation that values different perspectives #### **The Hiring Process** We’ll share details of the hiring stages with you during the application process. regional capabilities and alternatives that strengthen competitiveness and resilience. * Maintain strong knowledge of supplier capabilities, capacity, technology, financial health, and market Today, we are a world leading online trading group. **Join us to:** * Help build the future of online trading * Be part of a culture driven by integrity and global impact * Become part of an award-winning company - check out our full list of awards here **We are only as good as our people. Luckily, our people are the best. Join us!** **How do we work?** Hello SEO & ASO Experts! We are looking for a forward-thinking SEO & ASO Specialist to join our Warsaw team and spearhead our global web-to-app growth strategy. You won’t just be "adjusting keywords" - you will be bridging the gap between content-driven web discovery, App Store/Play Store visibility, and the new era of AI-driven recommendations. You will tackle the exciting challenge of scaling our visibility across multiple regions and multiple languages, ensuring our SEO and ASO efforts speak perfectly to diverse global audiences. As part of our global Marketing Department, you will join our currently 2-person SEO & ASO Team which we are expanding to support our growing digital footprint. We work in a hybrid model - we'd love to meet you in the office 2 times a week with respect to your own commitments. **In this role, you will:** * Conduct comprehensive, intent-driven keyword research that unifies web search and app store visibility across multiple international markets and languages. * Take ownership of the global visibility challenge; adapt and scale ASO and SEO strategies across diverse cultural and linguistic landscapes, ensuring local search intent is accurately met. * Architect a robust content map for our web properties; perform deep on-page SEO optimization for landing pages and editorial content to build a seamless, high-converting web-to-app funnel. * Use internal AI tools to research, test, and write high-converting app titles, subtitles, and descriptions for the App Store and Google Play at a fast pace. * Experiment with how apps are cited in AI-generated summaries (like Perplexity or Gemini) and ensure our app surfaces when users ask AI for "the best app for [niche]." * Identify and secure high-quality backlinks to our app store listings and landing pages, effortlessly distinguishing between high-authority, topically relevant links and low-quality sources like link farms, PBNs, or APK mirrors. * Audit and optimize visual assets (screenshots, icons, preview videos) and run A/B tests (Google Play Experiments / Apple Product Page Optimization) to turn impressions into installs. **What skillset do you need to be successful in this role?** * Hands-on experience acquiring quality backlinks to drive store authority and support web-to-app conversions; impact matters more than years. * Deep understanding of keyword ranking algorithms for both Apple App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android). * Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-region, and multi-language search campaigns, understanding the nuances of localization vs. direct translation. * Practical knowledge of App Store Connect and Google Play Console, including deep-linking concepts (Universal Links, App Links). * Fluent English. * Proven experience using AI tools with the ability to rapidly produce optimized metadata and localized drafts via AI-assisted workflows. * Genuine interest in how LLMs and NLP are reshaping app discovery, combined with the adaptability to respond quickly to algorithm updates and store policy changes. **Nice to have:** * Basic scripting skills (Python or JavaScript) to automate competitor keyword tracking, review scraping, or store data analysis. * Familiarity with low-code/no-code automation tools (Zapier, Make.com) to streamline keyword monitoring or app-featuring alerts. Your perspective matters. We encourage you to apply even if you are hesitant about meeting every single qualification. We are excited to see what you can bring to the team! \_\_\_ At OANDA, to help us efficiently process applications, we use AI-driven tools to help source and rank candidates based on professional experience and skills. While these tools provide recommendations, our recruitment process remains human-centric: all final shortlisting and hiring decisions are made by OANDA team. You have the right to request a human review of your application. OANDA Global Corporation is a diverse and global team with offices around the world. We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to OANDA. We are committed to creating and sustaining a collegial work environment in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and one which reflects the diversity of the community in which we operate. We provide an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Candidates selected for an interview will be contacted directly. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to provide as seamless a recruitment experience as possible. Review OANDA Privacy Policy and learn more about how we treat your personal data and protect your privacy.

title: Customer Logistic Experience Specialist
description: Job Description: **IMPACT starts with us. Be an Impact Maker.** At Schneider Electric, you will contribute to solving the climate crisis and accelerating the energy transformation that our planet urgently needs. You will work among colleagues with very diverse personal and professional experiences, united by a vision of a better world. **Location & commitments:** * Warsaw (office at Konstruktorska street), * Hybrid work model, * Permanent full-time contract after a probation period, * Smart onboarding with access to e-learning tools, * CSR & sustainability projects – make a real impact, * Growth path – we support your ambitions with development plan. **Your IMPACT** The Commercial Logistic Experience Specialist enhances the customer delivery experience through proactive and reactive logistics management. description: Location: Katowice Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: 15 Oct 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1752261 Location: Wrocław, Katowice, 2 days office/3 days remote **Integrated Data Enablement – Assistant Director** Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY. We are looking for an Assistant Director to be part of Global Data Stewardship Office. EY Global Delivery Services means 38.000 specialists providing globally IT, HR, finance, project management and strategic business services to EY member firms. In addition, we deliver support and solutions to clients from all over the world. EY GDS Risk Management Services (RMS) delivers a variety of compliance-related processes for enabling our business to deliver seamless, consistent, high-quality client service worldwide. **The opportunity** Join a high-impact team at the forefront of the organization's data transformation journey. As an Assistant Director within Global DSO, you will play a key role in shaping and operationalizing enterprise data management capabilities, partnering with senior stakeholders across business, technology, and governance functions. This is an opportunity to influence strategic data initiatives, drive adoption of modern data management practices, and help establish a scalable foundation that enables trusted, governed, and business-ready data across the enterprise. **Your key responsibilities** Data Enablement Strategy & Leadership * Support Global Data Stewardship Office in designing and implementing Integrated Data Enablement framework in alignment with enterprise data strategy and business objectives. * Identify strategic opportunities to improve data accessibility, usability, transparency, and value realization. * Assess existing operating models and identify opportunities for process optimization and control enhancement. Data Governance & Operating Model * Partner with governance bodies, data domain leaders, and stakeholders to implement governance frameworks. * Support the definition of roles, responsibilities, ownership, and accountability across data domains. * Drive alignment between policy, standards, processes, and technology capabilities. * Contribute to the evolution of the enterprise data operating model. Strategic Advisory & Stakeholder Management * Independently facilitate senior-level discussions focused on planning, implementation, and execution of strategic initiatives. * Communicate complex data concepts into clear business language suitable for executive audiences. * Partner with business, risk, legal, privacy, technology, and data management stakeholders to achieve program objectives. * Build strong relationships across the technology, risk management and data governance ecosystem. Executive Communication & Reporting * Prepare executive summaries, leadership briefings, presentations, and reporting materials for senior management and executive leadership teams. * Translate complex data risk, compliance, and governance topics into concise, actionable business insights. * Present recommendations, implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and strategic decisions to leadership audiences. * Develop materials supporting governance forums, steering committees, and executive decision-making processes. Program & Initiative Leadership * Develop implementation plans, monitor milestones, manage dependencies, and track delivery against strategic objectives. * Identify risks, challenges, and opportunities impacting delivery and proactively recommend mitigation strategies. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability of data risk processes. **Skills and attributes for success** * Proven ability to lead complex stakeholder discussions and independently drive implementation of strategic initiatives. * Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify alternative solutions and recommend actionable next steps. * Excellent communication and executive presence, including experience preparing and delivering presentations, executive summaries, and reporting to senior leadership. * Strong understanding of data governance, data risk management, data protection, and control frameworks within large organizations. * Understanding of modern data ecosystems and data enablement platforms. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and deliver results in a fast-paced and evolving environment. **To qualify for the role, you must have** * You should be fluent in English (C1) * 8+ years of related work experience * Proven experience implementing enterprise-level frameworks, operating models, governance programs, or strategic initiatives. * Experience interacting with senior leadership and executive stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to independently lead strategic conversations and drive initiative execution. * Experience preparing management reporting, executive summaries, dashboards, and presentation materials for leadership audiences. * Experience in Financial Services, Technology Risk, Data Risk, Data Compliance, Cyber Security and/or Information Security would be preferred **Ideally, you’ll also have** * Experience working within global, matrixed organizations. * Experience supporting large-scale transformation or change management initiatives. * IAPP certifications (CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM), DAMA certifications (CDMP) or equivalent privacy qualifications. * Knowledge of data governance and risk management industry frameworks. * Experience developing governance materials, steering committee updates, and executive communications. **What we look for** We are looking for a strategic delivery leader who combines strong data risk and governance expertise with executive presence, stakeholder management, and program leadership capabilities. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating independently, influencing senior stakeholders, navigating ambiguity, and driving the implementation of complex initiatives while translating technical and risk-related topics into meaningful business outcomes. **What we offer** EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. * **Continuous learning**: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. * **Success as defined by you**: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. * **Transformative leadership**: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. * **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. **About EY** **EY | Building a better working world** EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. **If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.** **The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.** In compliance with the requirements of the Whistleblower Protection Act, our company has established the Procedure for reporting breaches of law and undertaking appropriate follow-up actions. Any misconduct should be reported through the EY Ethics Hotline.

title: Development Manager - Product Teams
description: As Development Manager, you will lead one or two fully remote, cross-functional software development teams responsible for building and evolving OrbusInfinity, our flagship enterprise SaaS product. You will provide clear people leadership and delivery accountability, helping the teams focus on the work that matters most for our customers and the product. This is a hands-off leadership role: Technical Leads within the teams will own day-to-day technical decisions and help maintain technical standards and best practices. Your focus will be on coaching, guiding and enabling the teams to succeed. You will help the teams turn product goals into well-designed, maintainable software and deliver value to customers. You will work closely with Product and Engineering colleagues to create an environment of shared ownership, effective collaboration and continuous improvement. Your focus will be on ensuring that the teams operate within clear, effective delivery processes. You will ensure responsibilities are understood, agreed workflows are followed and engineering best practices are applied consistently, working with Technical Leads, Product Managers and other relevant roles to address process gaps and improve ways of working. Day-to-day backlog and delivery management will remain with the appropriate roles. You will be a strategic, people-first leader who earns the respect of skilled engineers not by doing their job, but by enabling them to do it brilliantly. This role is suited to an experienced Development Manager with several years of experience leading software development teams. You will bring previous hands-on experience as a software engineer or in another technical engineering role, together with enough technical understanding to ask the right questions, support sound decisions and lead the teams effectively. You will not be expected to be the hands-on technical owner. You will lead between 6 and 12 direct reports and work closely with Product, Engineering and senior technical leadership. The role is fully remote, based in Poland, with quarterly (max) in-person events bringing together teams from across all regions. You will be employed on a permanent contract (umowa o pracę) with our Polish entity. **Our engineering environment** OrbusInfinity runs natively in Microsoft Azure. Our technology landscape includes modern C#/.NET, React, TypeScript, Cosmos DB, SQL, containers and Kubernetes, with a micro-frontend and microservice architecture deployed continuously to highly available, multi-region infrastructure. We use Scrum for day-to-day development. Our engineering practices include automated CI/CD, shift-left testing and a focus on maintainable, high-quality code. Dedicated teams support build and release processes through Azure DevOps, Git and Azure. **Why this role matters** Your leadership will help one or two product development teams focus on the work that matters most, while enabling the wider engineering organisation to deliver and evolve OrbusInfinity with greater confidence. **What You Will Do** *Lead and develop the teams* * Lead, coach and develop one or two software development teams, supporting performance, engagement and career development. * Set clear expectations and support the growth of experienced technical professionals. * Hold regular one-to-ones and ensure direct reports have meaningful development plans. * Lead performance reviews, provide regular feedback and support career development for direct reports. * Lead hiring, onboarding and team capability development as required. * Create an environment in which technical professionals can work with appropriate autonomy and accountability. *Enable effective planning and delivery* * Support clear prioritisation and roadmap planning by ensuring the relevant roles are aligned on outcomes, dependencies and responsibilities. * Help translate strategic goals into clear priorities, outcomes and delivery expectations. * Ensure the appropriate roles maintain visibility of commitments, progress, risks and dependencies. * Help identify organisational blockers and escalate issues when decisions or support are needed. * Ensure cross-team dependencies and delivery risks have clear owners and are addressed early. * Work closely with Product Managers, Development Managers and senior Engineering leaders to coordinate priorities. * Ensure agreed delivery processes are understood and followed throughout the software development lifecycle, from planning and design through delivery and continuous improvement. * Work with Product Managers to understand roadmap goals, identify the technical runway needed to support them and make dependencies visible. *Contribute to strategy and continuous improvement* * Contribute to Product and Technology strategy, department-level initiatives and improvements to engineering standards. * Use team health, delivery and quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities and track progress. * Support changes to team shape, responsibilities and ways of working as the organisation evolves. *Support technical excellence and reliability* * Provide thoughtful challenge on technical proposals, trade-offs and delivery approaches. * Support the connection between technical decisions, product goals and wider engineering needs. * Support consistent engineering standards, quality and technical decision-making. * Encourage attention to maintainability, reliability and continuous improvement. *Enable effective engineering delivery* * Help the teams build, test, release and operate software effectively, working with relevant technical specialists where needed. * Support practical ways of working, tooling and collaboration that help engineers deliver with confidence. * Promote engineering quality, reliability and a culture of continuous improvement. * Ensure delivery and operational risks are visible, have clear owners and are followed through to completion. * Foster shared ownership and continuous delivery excellence across the Engineering department. *Work across Engineering* * Represent the teams in relevant product and engineering forums. * Support knowledge-sharing and collaboration across teams. * Contribute to improvements in engineering standards, processes and ways of working. * Build trusted relationships with Product, Engineering and senior technical stakeholders. * Connect people across teams and departments to find the best path to success. * Work closely with Technical Leads, Product Managers, other Development Managers and relevant technical specialists to resolve blockers, manage dependencies and improve ways of working. **What You Will Bring** *Essential* * Several years’ experience as a Development Manager or equivalent, leading software development teams. * Experience leading, coaching and developing software engineers. * Experience working with cross-functional, agile teams and guiding delivery through the full software development lifecycle. * Previous hands-on experience as a software engineer or in another technical engineering role. * Experience working with our technology stack or a closely related one, including modern C#/.NET, React, TypeScript and cloud-native technologies. * Good understanding of software development practices, technical delivery and engineering quality. * Experience owning or managing priorities, roadmaps, dependencies and delivery risks.\ * The ability to work effectively with technical specialists and support teams in making sound engineering decisions. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. * Experience working with distributed or international teams. * Fluency in English, as the working language of the team and wider organisation. *Nice to Have* * Familiarity with cloud, CI/CD or modern software delivery practices. * Experience working in a SaaS product company. * Experience partnering with Product Managers on roadmap planning and technical runway. * Experience leading or coordinating work across multiple software development teams. * Experience with multi-regional or high-availability infrastructure. * Experience with production incident management and operational improvement. * Experience hiring and building software development teams. * Experience contributing to technical strategy, architecture, reliability or production operations.\ * Experience working with agile delivery methods such as Scrum or Kanban. **A note on experience** We are interested in the capabilities that will help you succeed, not a perfect match with every tool or background listed above. Strong people leadership, delivery judgement and a solid technical foundation matter most. Specific product, cloud and engineering practices can be learned where the underlying judgement and curiosity are present.

fund budget, and various additional fun events in our office. * Free access to our e-learning platform, featuring over 1,000 courses. **Please attach an English version of your CV.** John Deere is an All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to, among other things, race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, status as a qualified individual with disability.

title: Facilities Coordinator
description: JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally. Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally. Facilities Coordinator **Location:** Krakow **Job Type:** Full-Time, Fully On-Site (Rolls-Royce Centre) **About the Role:** Ready to be the friendly face and steady hand behind a vibrant, high-profile workplace? As Facilities Coordinator at the Rolls-Royce Centre in Kraków, you'll be the welcoming first point of contact and the person who keeps day-to-day operations running smoothly. You'll work closely with the Facilities Manager, providing essential support across operational activities including accounting and finance, maintenance and operations, vendor oversight and helpdesk management. You'll also provide administrative support to keep the team organized and effective. Your week brings variety — no two days look the same — and there's real room to shape the role around your strengths and interests while building your facilities career with JLL, a leading global real estate and investment management firm. If you're organized, people-focused, and thrive in dynamic environments, we'd love to hear from you. **What you'll do:** Coordinate vendors and service partners — build positive working relationships, schedule activity (including occasional out-of-hours coordination), review documentation, and help ensure everyone on site is set up for success and ready to work safely. Champion safety and wellbeing — support a culture of care by participating in regular site checks, encouraging proactive safety habits across teams, and responding calmly and effectively when issues arise. Help keep systems running — coordinate troubleshooting and repairs for building systems like HVAC, lighting, and mechanical equipment. You'll learn to spot issues early and work with specialists to resolve them. Technical knowledge is helpful but can be developed on the job. Manage daily operations — handle service requests from logging through completion, coordinate office supplies and maintenance tracking, conduct regular site walks, and solve problems before they grow. Provide flexible support — step in across various duties including reception, facilities management backup, and other operational needs to ensure seamless service. Deliver exceptional client and stakeholder service — be the trusted point of contact, build relationships with key partners and the landlord, handle escalations with care, and identify opportunities to improve service and efficiency. Support finance and record-keeping — process purchase orders, track budgets, approve quotations within your authority, and maintain organized documentation. Contribute to resilience planning — help maintain business continuity plans, support risk management activities, and follow incident protocols. **Language:** Fluency in Polish and English is required. **What we're looking for:** A people-first approach — you're welcoming, approachable, and genuinely care about creating a safe, positive environment for everyone on site. Coordination and organizational skills — you can juggle multiple priorities, keep details organized, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Problem-solving mindset — when challenges arise, you stay calm, ask good questions, and work toward practical solutions. Willingness to learn — some familiarity with building systems (HVAC, electrical, mechanical) is a bonus, but we value curiosity and the ability to learn quickly just as much. Technical expertise can be built over time. Adaptability and flexibility — you're comfortable shifting between tasks (operations, reception, coordination) as the day demands and embrace change with a positive attitude. Clear communication — you can explain things clearly in writing and conversation, keeping stakeholders informed and documentation accurate. Comfort with technology — familiarity with facilities management tools like Service Now, Corrigo etc. is helpful, but the most important thing is a willingness to learn new systems. Self-motivation and initiative — you take ownership, spot opportunities to improve, and don't wait to be told what to do. **What you can expect from us:** **Competitive Rewards & Benefits:** Permanent contract after probation, private healthcare, cafeteria system, life insurance, and employee assistance program. **Career Development & Growth:** 80% of employees participate in structured development programs, with AI upskilling and ongoing professional training available. **Stability & Recognition:** 78% employee recommendation rate; recognized for 18 consecutive years as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies. **Inclusive & Supportive Culture:** Strong commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion across multiple employee resource groups and initiatives, with flexible pathways for career progression. **Global Perspective:** 60 nationalities and 40 languages represented, offering rich cultural exchange and collaboration opportunities. **Work-Life Flexibility:** We continually explore new ways to support flexibility and balance as our workplace practices evolve. If this resonates with you, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't tick every box. We're interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table. We value a can-do attitude and adaptability in this dynamic role where multitasking and flexibility are essential. It's an excellent opportunity for professionals looking to grow in facilities management. If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table! Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth: JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. About JLL – We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities. Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally. Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Data Migration & Transformation Consultant / Manager
description: **Technology Strategy & Transformation (TS&T) in Warsaw** supports organizations in shaping and executing **technology agendas** aligned with business priorities. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **Why Box needs you:** We are seeking an experienced Benefits Analyst based in Poland to join our International Total Rewards team. With a growing employee population in Poland and a range of locally specific benefits and leave processes, Box needs dedicated in-country expertise to deliver reliable operational support, ensure statutory compliance, and provide an exceptional Box-on-Box experience. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for Poland benefits and support leave administration while supporting broader EMEA/APAC initiatives. You will report to the Senior Team Manager and partner closely with People Partners, Payroll, Legal, Finance, and external vendors to deliver accurate, timely, and compliant benefits operations. You will also help identify opportunities to automate, simplify, document, and standardise processes. **What you'll do:** * Take day-to-day ownership of Poland benefits administration, acting as a key point of contact for Poland-based Boxers and managers on benefits eligibility, enrollment, policies and local programs. * Manage Benefits Service Desk cases through to resolution within agreed service levels, coordinating responses across Jira, email and Slack and escalating complex queries appropriately. * Support the full Boxer lifecycle, including benefits administration for new hires, employee changes and leavers, and deliver benefits induction sessions. * Provide trained administrative backup to the Leave of Absence Manager for Poland sickness, maternity, parental and other statutory and company-provided leave, maintaining accurate Workday records, trackers and supporting documentation. * Support routine employee and manager communications throughout the leave lifecycle, coordinating with People Operations, People Partners and Payroll, while escalating complex cases and return-to-work questions to the LOA Manager and relevant specialists. * Act as the Benefits team backup for the ZUS platform, supporting the reconciliation of statutory sickness and absence information with internal HR and payroll records. * Coordinate with benefit providers and vendors on enrollments, invoices, reconciliations, employee changes and issue resolution. * Support assigned EMEA/APAC benefits programs, including medical, risk insurance, pension, wellbeing and other local benefits, alongside primary responsibility for Poland operations. * Prepare and validate recurring benefits reports, vendor files and Workday uploads, including LuxMed files and assigned payroll, pension and leave-related reporting. * Partner with Payroll and Finance to deliver accurate benefits-related payroll inputs, invoice processing and reconciliations within agreed deadlines. * Maintain accurate benefits data across Workday, vendor platforms and internal records, completing regular audits, investigating discrepancies and coordinating corrections. * Coordinate Poland open enrollment and support all EMEA/APAC annual benefits renewals, maintaining timelines, employee communications, enrollment checks and follow-up actions. Support market reviews and benchmarking through data gathering and coordination with brokers and vendors. * Maintain benefits policies, FAQs, employee communications and process guides, documenting key controls, deadlines, ownership and escalation routes. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. * Bachelor's degree in HR, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience, with 2–4+ years of hands-on benefits administration experience (preferably in a multinational technology or shared-services environment). * Solid understanding of Total Rewards fundamentals, statutory benefits, and leave administration (including Polish sickness, parental, and statutory absence practices; familiarity with ZUS, PPK, and local insured benefits is a strong advantage). * Professional fluency in both English and Polish (written and verbal) is required to navigate local-language portals, statutory documentation, and vendor relationships. * Hands-on experience with Workday is required; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, audits, and reconciliations) with rigorous attention to data accuracy. * Proven ability to partner effectively with external brokers/insurers (renewals, invoicing, escalations) and internal teams (Payroll, People Operations, Legal, and Finance). * Proven ability to manage recurring operational activities and resolve issues using established processes. * Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. * Comfortable working with sensitive employee information and maintaining confidentiality. * Self-starter with a passion for process optimization, documenting workflows, and identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, or scale manual operations. **BENEFITS** Check out the overview of Life at Box which include general perks and benefits. description: **Job Title:** Associate,Risk & Controls Oversight **Contract Type:** 1 year fixed-term contract, full-time **Location:** Warsaw **Department:** Risk & Controls **Reporting to:** Head of Risk and Controls **What the Hiring Manager says….** *‘This is an exciting time to join the ICG Risk & Controls team. The role provides multiple opportunities to make a tangible impact on the Group’s delegate oversight function as we expand the governance offering and support ICG’s ambitious growth.’* You will gain extensive exposure to ICG’s diverse and rapidly growing private strategies. This position not only provides visibility across multiple key stakeholders and a very diverse spectrum of alternative asset fund strategies but also empowers the individual to shape how the organisation’s governance system and process is improved, making a significant impact on the future of our control function operations. The scope covers a wide array of tasks, including portfolio management delegate oversight, product lifecycle oversight, and production of relevant internal and external reporting while remaining abreast with fast evolving EU regulatory framework. **Summary of our opportunity** Intermediate Capital Group (ICG) is an FTSE-100 listed alternative asset manager with over 30 years' history, managing over $100bn of assets and investing across the capital structure. We operate across four asset classes: Structured and Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Assets, and Credit. The business employs over 500 people in 20 countries around the world and is well positioned for growth and benefits from the long-term trend of increased demand for alternative investments. The Risk & Controls Function team consists of professionals based in London, Luxembourg and Poland. The Control Functions (Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit) team operates across London, the US, Luxembourg and Poland. In addition to the permanent team, various external providers are used to supplement delivery, including risk, legal and regulatory advice. Reporting to the Luxembourg-based team, this role will primarily support product lifecycle oversight and delegated portfolio manager oversight. The scope includes new product approvals, post-NPA activities and sign-off, material fund changes and liquidations, together with the initial due diligence and ongoing monitoring of delegated portfolio managers. The role will also support the integration of ESG and sustainability considerations across these processes and the preparation of reporting to the Executive Committee and Board of Managers. Z O.O. **Profession (Job Category):** Human Resources **Job Schedule:** Full time **Remote:** No **Job Description:** **The opportunity** **Powering the world sustainably starts with the right people – and that begins with you!** We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition expert with strong technical affinity to drive and shape our R&D hiring strategy across Western Europe, with a particular focus on the German‑speaking market. This is not a role for someone who relies on a “post and pray” approach. It’s for someone who thrives on building deep networks, enjoys finding talent others struggle to reach, and takes pride in creating sustainable talent pipelines; not just for today’s demand, but for what’s coming next. In this role, you’ll partner closely with business leaders, HR teams, and our global Talent Acquisition community to attract critical technical talent in a highly dynamic and fast‑evolving energy environment. If you’re passionate about recruiting technical experts, enjoy working closely with operational teams, and want to play an active role in making the energy transition a reality, we would love to hear from you. **How you’ll make an impact** * Lead end-to-end recruitment for R&D profiles and other strategic engineering and operational positions. * Act as a trusted talent partner to hiring teams, translating complex technical and business requirements into effective recruitment strategies. * Drive proactive sourcing strategies and provide talent intelligence on market dynamics, competitor activity, skills availability, and emerging talent trends across the energy and industrial sectors. * Partner with the business on workforce planning, anticipate future capability needs, and build sustainable talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles. * Build strong partnerships with senior business leaders across the various business units, providing strategic guidance throughout the hiring process. * Align talent acquisition strategies with business priorities, operational requirements, and customer project demands. * Drive continuous improvement across recruitment processes, sourcing effectiveness, candidate experience, and stakeholder engagement. Represent Hitachi Energy at career fairs, technical events, and industry forums, strengthening our position as an employer of choice for technical talent. **Your background** * 5 - 7 years of experience in recruiting technical and engineering talent, ideally within energy, electrical engineering, industrial services, automation, or similarly complex environments. * Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to operate as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, engineering teams, and project organizations. * Strong expertise in proactive sourcing and talent mapping for specialized and hard-to-fill technical roles. * Ability to quickly understand complex technical profiles and business requirements and translate them into targeted recruitment and sourcing strategies. * Experience operating effectively within an international, matrixed organization and across multiple stakeholder groups. * Fluency in English; German would be a strong advantage. * Passion for people, data-driven decision making, and using talent insights to support business growth and the energy transition. **Accessibility and reasonable accommodation** **Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.** **This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.** **Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment** **As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.** **Background Screening and Security Checks** **As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.** **For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. title: Principal Engineer - Consumer & Merchant Experience
description: **Company Description** InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape. **We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.** We already have over **300,000 products** in our offer, we work with over **300 sellers**, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost **1.5 million users in Poland**. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, **we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey** - heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices. **Job Description** We are looking for a **Principal Engineer** to join our Consumer & Merchant Experience area at InPost Technology. This is a senior Individual Contributor role with an international scope and organization-wide impact. You will help define the long-term technology direction, shape architectural standards and solve complex technical problems spanning multiple teams and domains. You will work closely with Senior Engineering Directors, Engineering Managers, Staff and Principal Engineers, product teams and our CTO. This is not a people management position. Your impact will come from technical leadership, strategic thinking and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority. You will operate in a large and complex technology environment, supporting customer-facing products across multiple markets. The role combines defining target architecture with the practical challenge of moving away from legacy solutions while maintaining product delivery and software quality. You will: * define architectural standards across the technology organization; * identify and address systemic technical challenges spanning multiple domains; * shape engineering principles, practices and technology standards; * contribute to the organization’s technology strategy for AI; * lead cross-team and cross-domain technical initiatives; * mentor Staff Engineers and help develop the next generation of technical leaders; * support technical due diligence related to strategic partnerships and M&A; * represent InPost in the engineering community through conferences, publications and industry initiatives; * work with technical and business stakeholders to connect architectural direction with product needs. **Qualifications** **We are looking for someone who has:** * 10+ years of experience designing and developing large-scale distributed systems; * 3+ years of technical impact beyond a single team, in a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Architect or equivalent role; * experience making architectural decisions with long-term impact across multiple teams; * a strong engineering background and the ability to engage in detailed technical discussions, even though regular hands-on coding will not be the primary focus of the role; * experience building customer-facing products and influencing their technical and product direction; * experience establishing engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers; * proficiency in leveraging AI tools and large language models (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to enhance productivity, accelerate development, and solve complex problems. * ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and apply them responsibly within professional workflows. * experience working with public cloud and cloud-native architectures; * strong knowledge of scalability, reliability, observability, APIs and system integration; * the ability to communicate effectively with both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders; * professional proficiency in English at C1 level. **Nice to have** * Experience in logistics, e-commerce or marketplace environments. * Experience with on-premises to cloud migrations. * Experience designing large-scale mobile or web applications. * Knowledge of security and data protection. * Experience with payment, notification or tracking systems, including event-driven and real-time architectures. * Experience working in an international environment. * Previous experience in a managerial role. * Cloud certifications, such as GCP Professional Cloud Architect. **Technology background** **Java** is our preferred backend technology, but we are open to candidates from other backend ecosystems. What matters most is your depth of engineering experience, architectural judgment and track record of working with complex systems at scale. Experience with mobile and web applications will be valuable, as the role is strongly connected to customer-facing products **Additional Information** * Opportunity to work in a **diverse**, **international**, and **cross-functional environment,** along with leading **experts**. * You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership team, expanding your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industries. * InPost is a growing company that offers its people an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe. * Fulfilling careers with a **range of benefits** for people and investing in providing **training opportunities** for their development. * You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day. * Excellent working environment and flexible hours * **We offer B2B type of contract**

description: **Job Description:** As a **Senior Analyst** at AML RightSource, you will work directly with clients—including banks and non-bank financial institutions—to help detect and investigate unusual financial activity and mitigate financial crime risks. This role combines quality control responsibilities with hands-on analysis of account activity and client files, ensuring compliance with regulatory and operational policies through Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures. taking prototypes through to launch * Deep understanding of game architecture, design patterns and gameplay systems * Strong grasp of mobile optimization, profiling and performance constraints * Proven ability to own complex features end to end and make sound technical decisions independently * Experience reviewing code and mentoring other programmers * A problem-solving mindset and comfort in a fast-paced prototyping environment * Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach * Ability to deliver under tight deadlines and adapt quickly to feedback * Experience taking games through Soft Launch and live operations * Experience with game analytics, A/B testing and data-informed iteration * Strong English speaking skills for active communication both verbal and written with an international team **Bonus Points For** * Experience building internal tools, editor extensions or reusable frameworks in Unity * Experience with AI-assisted development workflows or tools * A portfolio, GitHub or shipped titles that show relevant gameplay work If this role excites you and you're ready to help shape the future of game development at Naphora, we encourage you to apply.

title: Młodszy Specjalista ds. audytów środowiskowych
description: Arcadis jest wiodącą na świecie firmą dostarczającą zrównoważone rozwiązania w zakresie projektowania, inżynierii oraz konsultingu dla zasobów naturalnych i obiektów budowlanych. Jesteśmy zespołem ponad 34 000 osób w ponad 30 krajach, których wspólnym celem jest poprawa jakości życia. Każdy z nas odgrywa ważną rolę. Dzięki sile wielu ciekawych umysłów możemy wspólnie rozwiązywać najbardziej złożone wyzwania świata i tworzyć jeszcze większy wpływ. **Młodszy Specjalista ds. Środowiska (K/M)** lokalizacja: Warszawa (hybrydowo) **Twoje obowiązki:** * Opracowywanie raportów środowiskowych typu Environmental Due Diligence fazy I. * Opracowywanie raportów zgodności z przepisami środowiskowymi (compliance). * Opracowywanie KIP i raportów o oddziaływaniu na środowisko. Doradztwo w zakresie środowiska dla projektów prowadzonych przez wszystkie działy Arcadis. **Nasze wymagania:** * Wykształcenie wyższe (ochrona środowiska, geologia lub pokrewne). * Dobra znajomość oprogramowania Microsoft Office. * Zaawansowana znajomość języka angielskiego, w tym słownictwa specjalistycznego i biznesowego. * Znajomość polskiego prawodawstwa w zakresie prawa ochrony środowiska i pokrewnych. * Umiejętność analitycznego myślenia i wyszukiwania ogólnodostępnych danych. * Samodzielność i komunikatywność. * Dyspozycyjność, gotowość do podróży służbowych. Prawo jazdy kat. B. **Oferujemy:** * Pakiet benefitów, m.in: opieka medyczna, ubezpieczenie na życie i od NNW. * Comiesięczne doładowania kart w systemie kafeteryjnym MyBenefit (w tym możliwość podłączenia karty Multisport). * Dofinansowanie nauki języków obcych. * Zwrot kosztów uczestnictwa w dowolnie wybranej organizacji zawodowej. * Indywidualne podejście do rozwoju każdego Arkadyjczyka dzięki metodzie GPS. * Udział w programie Workplace Options (opieka psychologiczna, doradztwo m.in. prawne, kredytowe). **Dlaczego Arcadis?** Możemy osiągać nasze cele wyłącznie wtedy, gdy każdy ma przestrzeń, by być najlepszą wersją siebie. Wierzymy, że wkład każdego pracownika ma znaczenie. Dlatego jako jedni z pionierów rozwijamy podejście oparte na kompetencjach, które umożliwia wykorzystanie unikalnego doświadczenia i wiedzy do kształtowania własnej kariery oraz maksymalizowania wpływu, jaki możemy wywierać razem. W Arcadis wykonujesz pracę, która ma znaczenie — niezależnie od stanowiska przyczyniasz się do tworzenia zrównoważonych rozwiązań na rzecz bardziej prosperującej planety. Zostaw swój ślad: w swojej karierze, wśród współpracowników, u klientów, w swoim życiu i w świecie, który nas otacza. Razem możemy stworzyć trwałe dziedzictwo. **Dołącz do Arcadis. Twórz Dziedzictwo.** **Nasze zobowiązanie w zakresie Równości, Różnorodności, Inkluzywności i Przynależności** Chcemy, abyś każdego dnia mógł/mogła wnosić do pracy to, co najlepsze — dlatego traktujemy równość bardzo poważnie i rozliczamy się z naszych działań. Naszą ambicją jest być pracodawcą z wyboru i zapewniać doskonałe miejsce pracy wszystkim naszym ludziom Wierzymy, że różnorodne zespoły, łączące osoby o odmiennych doświadczeniach, tworzą najbardziej innowacyjne idee. Równość, różnorodność i inkluzja są kluczowymi elementami naszej misji poprawy jakości życia — realizujemy je wspólnie w ramach sześciu obszarów ED&I: Wiek, Niepełnosprawność, Wiara, Płeć, LGBT+ oraz Rasa. Zróżnicowany i wysoko wykwalifikowany zespół jest niezbędny do naszego sukcesu. Przedział wynagrodzenia dla tego stanowiska wynosi 5,433 - 8150 PLN brutto.

description: At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. In this role you will be responsible for the collection, validation, and tracking of tax documentation for our custody client base, ensuring the proper setup for initial tax withholding purposes, the proper maintenance for ongoing tax withholding purposes, and the resolution of client inquiries. This position entails participation in client calls and due diligence visits, for which strong English language communication skills are a necessity. The day to day also involves proactively working with client service and relationship managers on escalations of tax documentation/tax compliance issues and / or requirements for clients. **In our team, you will be responsible for:** * Perform administrative matters with respect to the review, communication, and maintenance with respect to our custody clients’ tax documentation. * Develop an understanding of the market’s regulatory environment, tax documentation requirements, eligible entity types, and withholding tax environment for assignment countries/client base. * Perform account and market reconciliations often with the opportunity to collaborate with our Tax Research department. * Review changes in account information to determine impact on client tax documentation and requirements and work together with Senior Analysts and Manager on resolutions. * Participate in the solicitation process for new documentation, as necessary, as well as prior to expiration and work with assigned client service base to proactively solicit. * Assume additional tax functions as business needs develop. * Review and respond to internal client inquiries relating to tax compliance, tax reporting matters or tax documentation matters. * Participate in client calls and due diligence visits. * Escalate to manager on tax documentation/ compliance issues to mitigate risk for BBH and its clients. * Work with the team to establish and/or improve procedures for tax compliance related activities. * Assist with business requirements and testing of systems changes. * Participate in client projects such as conversions/new fund launches to ensure tax documentation requirements are understood and met by the Client/Client Service Group. * Proactively works with client service managers and relationship managers to escalate tax documentation / tax compliance requirements for clients. **What we’re looking for:** * BA/BS or equivalent combination of experience and/or education * Tax knowledge/ experience preferred * Written and oral communication skills with ability to convey information to internal and external clients in a clear, focused, assertive and concise manner. * Highly organized, detail oriented, self-motivated, capable of monitoring and completing a variety of projects simultaneously. * Ability to work in a potentially high pressure, client driven environment, under daily deadlines **What we offer:** * To encourage cultural awareness and philanthropy, BBHers have 1 Culture Celebration Day and 1 Community Service Day in addition to their paid standard vacation allowance * Private medical care * Life Insurance * Employee Assistance Program - offering independent and confidential counselling services for you and your family. You can get support for topics including family, marriage and relationships, finances, and legal issues. * Professional trainings and qualification support * Wellbeing Program * Online Social Fund benefit platform * Social, sport and integration events * Onboarding Program for new hires **We value diverse experiences.** We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply. **About BBH:** Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us. We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another. We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.
