Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will lead the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams and take each cycle from first draft to sign-off: consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, the multi-entity close, regulatory returns to the GFSC and FCA, and the external audit. You will apply IFRS to crypto assets, shape our accounting positions and policies, and work with our finance transformation team to build AI and automation into the close and reporting process. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Financial reporting and control** * Prepare the group's consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, from first draft to sign-off. * Run month-end and year-end close for a multi-entity group in Gibraltar and the UK, including consolidation and intercompany eliminations. * Oversee the statutory accounts of each group entity. * Make sure the internal control system stays accurate and keeps its integrity. **Regulatory reporting** * Lead regulatory reporting to the GFSC and FCA, including prudential returns on capital and liquidity and periodic management accounts. * Work with Data, Operations, Compliance and other teams to prepare client asset reporting. * Keep up with regulatory change and update reporting when requirements change. **External audit** * Run the group external audit from planning through fieldwork, queries and sign-off. * Be the main contact between Xapo and the auditors, answering technical questions and keeping the audit on timetable. **Technical accounting** * Support the Director of Finance on technical accounting, including the treatment of crypto assets under IFRS. * Write technical accounting positions and contribute to decisions on finance systems and infrastructure. * Help draft accounting policies, memos and decision records. **Tax** * Own tax compliance and manage the external tax advisors, including the tax treatment of crypto assets. **Systems, process and automation** * Improve finance processes and NetSuite reporting. * Work with the finance transformation team to build AI and automation into close and reporting, and adopt new tools as they roll out. * Manage the existing close and regulatory reporting review process and look for ways to improve it. **Team management** * Lead and develop the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams, fostering strong performance, accountability, and collaboration. * Drive a high-performance culture by setting clear objectives, developing future leaders, and ensuring the team has the skills to support evolving business and regulatory requirements. **Skills needed** ----------------- * Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field. * Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) preferred. * At least 5 years as a Controller leading an accounting function. * Experience in a bank, fintech or crypto business. * Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and FRS 102, with experience preparing financial statements under both. * Crypto asset accounting under IFRS, including fair value revaluation and on-chain reconciliations, backed by a working understanding of blockchain. * Regulatory reporting experience, including Basel capital and liquidity returns (e.g. COREP). GFSC or FCA exposure is preferred. * External audits experience. * NetSuite proficiency is essential. * Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. SQL or BI tools (e.g. BigQuery, Looker) are an advantage. * Has used AI tools in previous finance roles and is comfortable working alongside AI-driven automations and checking their output. * Experience leading and developing a finance team. * Clear writer, able to explain complex numbers to non-finance colleagues and handle regulator and auditor correspondence in a fully remote team. * Strong analytical skills, sound judgement and high standards of integrity. **Other requirements** ---------------------- * A dedicated workspace. * A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. * Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. **Why work for Xapo?** ---------------------- Impact Globally, Work Remotely. * **Shape the Future** Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world. * **Great work-life balance** Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. * **Expect Excellence** Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals. At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

title: Tax Manager, Foreign Tax Reporting and Compliance
description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon's EMEA Direct Tax Reporting & Compliance team is scaling fast - and we're building the next generation of tax operations with AI-driven automation - not spreadsheets. Join us in Warsaw as a Tax Manager and help drive direct tax compliance for Amazon's portfolio in Europe, with a primary focus on Poland. You'll own tax reporting and compliance for a portfolio of Amazon's EMEA legal entities, working directly with cross-functional partners across Accounting, Legal, and Transfer Pricing. You'll be part of a team actively deploying GenAI and automation tools to modernize how tax compliance gets done at scale. You'll gain exposure to high-complexity, high-visibility work: statutory filings, tax authority correspondence, audits, and cross-border restructuring projects The successful candidate will be a highly organized self-starter with strong problem-solving and communication skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to operate independently while working proactively across multiple functional teams in a deadline-driven environment. Beyond managing the compliance portfolio, this person is genuinely motivated to make things better - identifying inefficiencies, driving automation, and continuously raising the bar on how the work gets done. Experience leveraging technology and AI tools to deliver those improvements is highly valued. Key job responsibilities Working within the EMEA Foreign Reporting & Compliance team, Tax Manager will: * Manage income tax compliance, including corporate income tax returns and income tax payments across the assigned portfolio * Support income tax accounting and reporting under US GAAP and local GAAP and review international aspects of Amazon's worldwide income tax provision * Manage relationships with external tax advisors and support tax controversy teams on audits - Own process improvement initiatives - identify automation and simplification opportunities, drive reduction in in manual effort, and develop standard procedures for compliance and reporting processes * Partner cross-functionally with Direct Tax Technology and Tax Transformation teams to resolve systemic issues and automate recurring calculations and corporate tax requirements * Participate in special projects, including tax due diligence and integration support for M&A * Research and document technical tax and tax accounting issues across the assigned portfolio; work with external advisors to assess the impact of new laws and regulations on Amazon's structure and business About the team The Amazon Tax department is a fast-paced, collaborative, high-ownership environment. The EMEA Foreign Reporting & Compliance team manages the worldwide tax-related filings and local tax reporting compliance of Amazon's foreign entities - a portfolio growing in scale and complexity as the business expands across the region. We pair deep tax technical expertise with a strong focus on process improvement and automation, including AI, to modernize tax compliance. Team members collaborate closely with Accounting, Legal, and Transfer Pricing across multiple countries, and own their portfolio of entities and jurisdictions from day one. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Experience a compliance focused tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization * Experience with accounting concepts and tax regulations, laws and standards * Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization * Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field * Speak, write, and read fluently in Polish * Strong tax operational background with a track record of managing complex, multi-jurisdiction compliance portfolios **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Master's degree * Polish Certified Tax Advisor (Doradca Podatkowy) * Technical aptitude to independently build and maintain solutions — not only to identify what needs to be done, but to design and implement it; comfortable working at the intersection of tax and technology Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. title: Polish speaking Interpreter
description: **About the Opportunity** Expansion International is partnering with our client, a healthcare interpreting and language services provider, to build out a team of Medical Video Remote Interpreters across multiple languages, including Polish. This is a newly scaling programme, so we are recruiting a number of interpreters as our client grows its remote interpreting capacity across the US healthcare system. The role sits fully remote and connects healthcare professionals with patients who are more comfortable communicating in a language other than English, primarily through video, with occasional over-the-phone sessions. This is a genuine route into a career in medical interpreting. Full training is provided, and previous professional interpreting experience is a bonus rather than a requirement, provided you can demonstrate strong bilingual fluency and a real understanding of what interpreting involves. **The Role** As a Medical Video Remote Interpreter, you will facilitate clear, accurate communication between English speaking healthcare providers and Polish speaking patients, without adding, omitting, or changing the meaning of what is said. Sessions take place on camera, so a professional presence and a dedicated, quiet workspace are essential. This is a client facing role. You will interact directly with patients and healthcare professionals in sensitive, and sometimes high pressure, medical situations, so composure, confidentiality, and cultural sensitivity matter as much as language skill. Candidates go through a structured evaluation process (resume review, phone interview, recorded prescreen, a medical interpreting proficiency assessment, and a final interview), and successful candidates complete a foundations training programme before starting live sessions. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide accurate, complete, and respectful video interpreting between English and Polish, with occasional over-the-phone sessions. * Facilitate communication faithfully, without adding, omitting, or altering the speakers' meaning. * Follow professional interpreter ethics, standards of practice, and company procedures. * Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable healthcare privacy requirements. * Demonstrate cultural responsiveness and respect for differing backgrounds, communication styles, and patient preferences. * Maintain professional conduct before, during, and after each session, and use sound judgement around interpreter role boundaries. * Adapt to evolving technology, workflows, and service requirements. * Take part in required training, coaching, and quality related activities. **Required Skills & Experience** * Fluent, professional level verbal communication in both English and Polish. * A genuine understanding of what medical interpreting involves. This can come from informal experience, such as interpreting for family members, rather than formal employment. * Ability to interpret medical information accurately and completely in both languages. * Willingness to complete a medical interpreting proficiency assessment as part of the selection process. * Cultural responsiveness and comfort working within the US healthcare context. * Strong professional reliability and sound judgement, with a customer service mindset. * Comfort working with video conferencing platforms and adapting to new remote technology. * Able to pass background and drug screening. * A dedicated home workspace reserved for this role: a private, distraction-free room with a door that locks, where no one else can see your screen while you work, and wired high speed internet (no Wi-Fi, hotspot, satellite, or DSL). This is not a typical work-from-anywhere remote role, given the confidential nature of the sessions. * Comfortable being on camera for the majority of each shift. * Based in Poland, available to work remotely. * Please note this role will require working night shift hours, aligned with US Eastern Time (ET); exact schedule to be confirmed. **Nice to Have** Experience with any of the following would be advantageous but is not essential: * Previous medical interpreting experience in a hospital, clinic, or healthcare setting. * Formal medical interpreter training, or a related certificate or degree. * National medical interpreter certification (for example CCHI or NBCMI), where available for the language. * Experience interpreting over video or telephone platforms. * Working knowledge of medical terminology in English and Polish. **We're Looking For Someone Who** * Is eager to learn and grow into a professional interpreting career, not just apply existing experience. * Stays calm, composed, and professional under pressure, including in sensitive or emotional conversations. * Takes feedback well and acts on it. * Presents a professional, camera-ready image and shows up reliably for scheduled sessions. * Has a genuine respect for patient confidentiality and dignity. **Preferred Background** We are particularly interested in professionals who have experience working in: * Healthcare or clinical support roles. * Customer service, call centre, or BPO environments with a high standard of professionalism. * Language services, translation, or interpreting, whether formal or informal. **Why Join This Opportunity?** * Full-time, permanent, fully remote role with meaningful, patient-facing work in healthcare. * Structured training programme before you start live sessions. * A clear route into a specialist, in-demand profession. * Supportive onboarding, with equipment provided once workspace requirements are met. **Benefits:** * Paid Time Off * Work From Home * Training & Development * Equipment provided Job Types: Full-time, Permanent Pay: 6,400.00zł - 8,200.00zł per month Application Question(s): * How would you rate your spoken English fluency? (Native or near-native, Fluent, Advanced conversational, Intermediate, Basic) * Have you fully read and understood the job description? (Y/N) * Have you ever interpreted for someone, even informally (for example for a family member), or closely observed interpreting being done? (Y/N) * Do you have any current job, study schedule, or other commitment that would conflict with a full-time night shift role? (Y/N) * This role requires a dedicated, private room at home with a door that locks, where no one else can see your screen while you work. This is not a typical work-from-anywhere remote role. Do you currently have access to a space like this? (Y/N) * Do you have a wired, high-speed internet connection available in that space? (Not Wi-Fi, a mobile hotspot, satellite, or DSL.) (Y/N) * Are you comfortable being on camera for most of your shift? (Y/N) * This role requires passing a background check and drug screening before starting. Are you willing and able to undergo these? (Y/N) * This is a full-time, permanent role might require night shift hours aligned with US Eastern Time. Are you able to commit to this schedule? (Y/N) * How would you rate your spoken Polish fluency? (Native or near-native, Fluent, Advanced conversational, Intermediate, Basic) Work Location: Remote

The role focuses on controlled engineering design, documentation, quality, and approved verification processes. **Work Experience** **Key Responsibilities** * Support mechanical design activities for defense-related components. * Prepare and review CAD models, drawings, and engineering documents. * Check designs against approved technical requirements and standards. * Support design reviews, engineering changes, and verification activities. * Work with quality, manufacturing, and authorized technical specialists. **Required Skills & Experience** * 3–5 years of experience in mechanical design or product development. * Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. * Good knowledge of Siemens NX, Creo, CATIA, or similar CAD tools. * Understanding of mechanical materials, tolerances, and manufacturing processes. * Experience working with controlled technical documentation. * English at B2 level or higher. **Nice to Have** * Experience in aerospace, defense, or other safety-critical industries. * Knowledge of FEA, configuration management, and formal design review processes. **Benefits** * Private healthcare (Medicover) – comprehensive private medical care. * Professional development – access to technical training and language courses to support your career growth. * Opportunity to work on innovative Aerospace & Aviation projects with leading global customers. * On-site collaboration with the client in a dynamic international engineering environment. * Salary range: our budget for this role is between PLN 9,000 - 10,500 gross per month.

title: GIS Installation Specialist
description: We welcome applications from candidates across Poland, as this role is primarily based on international project assignments and not tied to a specific local office location. **A Snapshot of Your Day** Are you a passionate electrical engineer or technician eager to take your career to the next level? Do you thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy hands-on work? If so, we want you to be part of our team! As a GIS installation specialist, you will play a crucial role in implementing our projects in diverse locations, often requiring extended periods abroad. Your work will directly contribute to our efforts in promoting sustainable energy solutions and advancing global electrification initiatives. **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Conduct on-site mechanical and electrical assembly and troubleshooting of GIS equipment, ensuring a practical, hands-on approach to problem-solving. * Prioritize health and safety by adhering to all safety protocols and regulations, conducting risk assessments, and ensuring a safe working environment for yourself and your team. * Collaborate with project teams to ensure timely and efficient project execution, contributing to the electrification of communities and industries while maintaining high safety standards. * Perform inspections and assessments to ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, while aligning with our sustainability goal, and provide technical support and training to local teams and clients, empowering them to adopt and implement our innovative solutions safely and effectively. * Document findings, prepare reports, and communicate effectively with stakeholders including project teams, customers and partners. * Adapt to various working conditions and cultures while maintaining a positive attitude and a strong commitment to health and safety practices. **What You Bring** * A degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent technical experience. * Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges. * Willingness to travel extensively, with availability for travel abroad 80-90% of the time. * Fluency in English, with outstanding communication skills, is essential. * A proactive attitude and a passion for learning and professional growth. **About the Team** Our Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. **Who is Siemens Energy?** At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo **Our Commitment to Diversity** Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. **Rewards/Benefits** * Medical care * Life insurance * Lunch card (300 PLN a month) * Pension Fund * SE Equity plans * Additional monthly budget for benefits in cafeteria *To ensure a fair evaluation, please submit your CV in English, as applications in other languages cannot be reviewed.*

You will act as the **local point of contact for outsourcing matters**, working closely with Group Outsourcing, Service Management, Technology GRC & TPRM, Risk, Compliance and business stakeholders. identification and risk assessment through approval, contracting and onboarding to ongoing monitoring, remediation and exit. * Coordinate local outsourcing assessments and governance reviews, material sub-outsourcing arrangements, dependencies and concentration risks. * Maintain accurate and complete local Outsourcing and DORA Registers. * Coordinate regulatory notifications, submissions, supervisory requests, inspections and audits related to outsourcing. * Ensure local outsourcing arrangements comply with DORA, EBA Outsourcing Guidelines and applicable local requirements. * regulatory findings, and track remediation through to closure. * Act as the key local interface between Group Outsourcing and local stakeholders across Risk, Compliance, Procurement, Legal, ICT and Operational Resilience. * Provide guidance and awareness on outsourcing governance and regulatory expectations to local stakeholders. * Support the local outsourcing governance committee and provide regular reporting on outsourcing exposure, key risks, critical providers, incidents and regulatory developments. **Requirements** * Relevant experience in outsourcing, third-party/vendor risk, operational risk or a related area within financial services. * Strong knowledge of DORA, EBA Outsourcing Guidelines, operational resilience and ICT third-party risk. * Experience with outsourcing inventories and regulatory registers, due diligence, risk assessments and governance reporting. * Experience monitoring service levels, KPIs, SLAs and third-party performance. * Understanding of outsourcing lifecycle management, including risk assessment, contracting, monitoring, remediation and exit planning. * Ability to work independently across local and Group-level functions and coordinate stakeholders in a complex regulatory environment. * Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills. * Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving abilities. * Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and escalate risks when required. **Benefits** * **Flexible Work Arrangements:** Offer adaptable schedules to maintain work-life balance. * **Attractive Rewards System**: Recognize commitment and effort with generous rewards structure. * **Sport Card Benefit**: Encourage fitness and wellness with access to multiple sports facilities. * **Private medical care:** Prioritize employee health with private world-class medical care. * **Life Insurance**: Ensure financial security and preparedness for the future with a robust life insurance plan. * **Employee Referral Program:** Recognize talent acquisition contributions with a rewarding referral program.

title: UX Designer
description: **Location:** Krakow, Lesser Poland, Poland **Job ID:** R0142956 **Date Posted:** 2026-10-12 **Company Name:** HITACHI ENERGY SERVICES SP. Z O.O. **Profession (Job Category):** Creative & Design **Job Schedule:** Full time **Remote:** No **Job Description:** **The opportunity** The User Experience (UX/UI) Designer is an integral member of the User Experience practice, working directly with product, engineering and delivery teams. The role partners with product managers, product owners and domain experts to establish an evidence-based product vision for a complex power-automation engineering ecosystem. The environment for which we are seeking a specialist combines technical configuration workflows, multiple applications and interfaces of a different age, specialised user roles, safety- and reliability-sensitive operations, and dependencies among software, devices and engineering processes. We are seeking an experienced UX professional to work independently on engineering applications UX/UI. The successful candidate will perform research work based on identified product needs, plan UX/UI work, map complex engineering workflows, conduct stakeholder and user interviews, evaluate usability of existing applications and produce high-quality, evidence-based UX deliverables. This position requires effective communication, good problem framing skills, proactive ownership, attention to detail, timely delivery and the ability to build productive stakeholder relationships through evidence and design thinking. The initial focus is to understand the engineering environment, workflows, target users, risks and product opportunities, and to establish a reliable foundation for future product and design decisions. **How You Will Make an Impact** * Plan and execute an end-to-end design thinking process. * Work with product and engineering stakeholders to clarify business objectives, scope, assumptions and decision points. * Review existing documentation, issue reports, backlog items, designs, training materials and technical artefacts. * Prepare research activities, interview scripts, usability-testing scenarios and information synthesis approaches. * Conduct stakeholder interviews and contextual or workflow-focused user interviews. * Map complex, multi-stage engineering and configuration workflows, including inputs, outputs, decisions, dependencies, error conditions, handovers and workarounds. * Identify where workflows are fragmented across applications, scripts, documents or manual processes. * Distinguish validated evidence from assumptions, stakeholder opinions and technical constraints. * Convert findings into role-based user archetypes, jobs-to-be-done, journey or workflow maps, service blueprints, use cases and clear problem statements. * Build a traceable relationship between research evidence, user needs, risks, application capabilities and UX recommendations. * Produce a prioritized UX opportunity backlog and contribute UX evidence to product strategy and roadmap decisions. * Define UX and UI requirements to deliver a consistent experience across touchpoints. Present complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. **Your Background** * 3+ years of professional UX experience, including experience in one of the following disciplines: Information Architecture, Product Design or Service Design, with a strong research component. * Demonstrable work on at least one substantial UX/UI project for a complex enterprise, industrial, engineering, scientific, healthcare, financial, cybersecurity or other specialist system. * Experience researching complex workflows or systems. * Ability to model complex dependencies and alternative flows. * Evidence of turning ambiguous and conflicting stakeholder input into actionable design delivery plan. * Strong synthesis skills: affinity analysis, workflow mapping, service blueprinting, user archetypes, jobs-to-be-done and problem framing. * Experience conducting UX audits or heuristic evaluations of mature applications. * Ability to communicate research findings in a concise, decision-oriented form. * Ability to work independently. * Professional English sufficient for interviews, workshops and documentation in an international environment. * Bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, information sciences and/or HCI is a plus. * Experience facilitating workshops with senior, technical and cross-functional participants is a plus. Experience with industrial automation, energy, utilities, engineering software, products that combine software with physical devices or embedded systems, or configuration tools is a strong plus. **More About Us** At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives. **Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:** * Private medical care and life insurance * Access to fitness and wellness programs * Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks * Employee Capital Plans (PPK) * Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home * Spectacles and contact lenses allowance * Company events and team‑building activities * Psychological support program * Free parking available Add if applicable : additional benefits may apply depending on the role, grade, and business requirements. **You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.** **Accessibility and reasonable accommodation** **Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.** **This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.** **Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment** **As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.** **Background Screening and Security Checks** **As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.** **For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.** **The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

description: Job details Commercial & Customer Care Wroclaw Full-time Hybrid zł 160,000 PLN - zł 200,000 PLN ### **THIS IS US** Dott is the European champion of shared micromobility, powering over 500 million rides across 400 cities and 17 countries across Europe and the Middle East. Come as you are and join our ride! In case you are living with disabilities, chronic illness, or neurodiversity, please inform us, so we can ensure a smooth application process. If we could spark your interest and you want to change mobility for good with us, apply now and let us know why you’re the one for the job! We encourage everyone to apply and grow with us. Even if you may not tick all the boxes of the requirements, we are happy to hear about the value you can add to the team. We are all learners! description: Company Description Techland is one of the biggest video game companies in Poland, with over 30 years of experience in the gaming industry. From our studios in Wrocław and Warsaw, we’ve built an international team of more than 500 talented professionals, all dedicated to pushing the boundaries of game development. Job Description The Outsourcing & Procurement Manager is responsible for building and managing a network of vendors and external studios, ensuring production has access to the right partners at the right quality, cost, and speed, while securing contracts that protect intellectual property and project schedules. The role involves close collaboration with Producers, Legal, Finance, and Marketing. **Your daily tasks:** Procurement strategy and vendor sourcing Develop and implement procurement strategy per project and per category. **Source and evaluate external partners for:** – Art production – Co-development – QA, Mocap, Localization and LQA – Marketing and PR partners. **Run end-to-end sourcing processes:** RFI/RFP/RFQ, supplier evaluation, negotiation, and award. Maintain a preferred-vendor network with benchmarked rates, capacity, and quality ratings. Contracts and commercial negotiation **Negotiate and structure agreements with Legal:** MSAs, SOWs, work-for-hire, milestone-based payments, etc. Protect our IP through clear ownership and assignment clauses, NDAs, credit terms, and third-party asset and licensing rules. Tie payments to milestone acceptance criteria and define penalties, rework terms, and termination rights. Manage procurement of software and tools. Maintain a contract repository and track key dates, obligations, and renewals. Vendor management and delivery Onboard vendors, covering pipelines, tools, communication channels, and style guides, together with production teams. Run regular vendor reviews with KPIs such as on-time delivery, first-pass acceptance rate, defect rate, and responsiveness. Handle escalations, disputes, and vendor transitions with minimal disruption to the production schedule. Risk, security, and compliance **Assess vendor risk:** financial stability, key-person dependency, capacity, geopolitical exposure, and sanctions or regional restrictions. Ensure compliance with data protection (GDPR), anti-corruption, labor and contractor regulations. Build contingency plans and backup vendors for critical dependencies. Improve procurement processes, approval workflows, and vendor data management. Qualifications 5+ years in procurement, vendor management, or outsourcing management, with at least 3 years in the games industry or a closely related creative or digital industry. Hands-on experience managing external development, art, QA, or localization vendors on shipped titles. Strong negotiation skills and a solid grasp of contracts, SOWs, IP ownership, and milestone-based payment models. Understanding of game production pipelines and milestone structures. Analytical skills and comfort with budgets, rate cards, and spend reporting. Excellent communication and stakeholder management across cultures and time zones. Fluent English and Polish. Key Competencies Commercial thinking balanced with respect for creative quality. Negotiation and relationship building. Risk awareness and attention to contractual detail. Organization under tight, shifting production schedules. Collaboration with creative and technical teams. Additional Information **What we offer:** **A wide array of benefits:** private medical care, life insurance, pro-health campaigns, gifts for different occasions. An outstanding work atmosphere in a highly-skilled team of professionals, with flexible working hours, no dress code, and full support of the dedicated HR Business Partner. A constant stream of company newsletters, PR & project updates so you will always be in the know. **Many opportunities for personal development:** a dedicated development budget for each employee, extra two paid days for training and CSR, stable career paths, extensive internal and external training, and financing of English and Polish language classes. State-of-the-art offices filled with chillout zones, a fully equipped kitchen, a gym (Wrocław office), and a free car park (Warsaw limited amount of space).

title: Senior CRO Strategist

Requirements: **Essential** * 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing. * Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization. * Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests. * Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions. * Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. * Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. * Excellent project management and organizational skills. * Exceptional communication skills. * Proficient English language skills. * Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation. **Nice to Have** * Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries. * Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube. * Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization. * Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools. **﻿****Why do we deserve your attention?** Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Z O.O. **Profession (Job Category):** Legal, Compliance & Audit **Job Schedule:** Full time **Remote:** No **Job Description:** **The opportunity** Internal Audit is an independent and objective organization and an integral part of the Finance function. In the current set-up, the Internal Audit department supports occasionally the Office of Special Investigations (OSI) in investigating alleged integrity violations of the Hitachi Group Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and internal policies, end-to-end lifecycle management of integrity concerns and reports outcomes to the appropriate disciplinary and decision-making bodies. In the future set up, the newly created Forensic Audit team will fully dedicate their resources in supporting on any alleged integrity violations related to finance and forensic accounting, but will also assist in other so-called “License to Operate” investigations (such as Bribery & Corruption, Conflicts of Interest, theft, embezzlement, and other fraud related issues). The **Forensic Audit Manager** strengthens this mandate as head of the Forensic Audit team (in total 3 to 4 individuals) but will also be working within the operations of the investigation process. Acting as OSI’s extended investigative arm and as the subject matter expert for finance and forensic accounting, the role leads assigned investigative work and supports investigations led by OSI across the full investigation lifecycle. Integrity investigations include complex, sensitive and cross-border investigations. **How you will make an impact** * You will work under OSI’s case ownership and direction while applying independent, objective and professionally qualified investigative expertise. Key responsibilities include: * Managing the end-to-end lifecycle of investigating integrity concerns and/or supporting OSI in any step in their investigations. This includes the intake process, data collection & analysis, interview and reporting phase. * Acting as the subject matter expert for finance and forensic accounting. Reconstruct transactions, follow funds, quantify potential loss or exposure, identify control circumvention, and assess indicators of fraud, bribery, corruption, conflicts of interest, and other integrity concerns (‘License to Operate’ concerns). * Using data analytics and technology with your knowledge of and experience. Key systems include SAP S/4HANA and related platforms such as Ariba, Concur and other business systems. Using Power BI, Tableau or comparable tools, and using E-Discovery tools (Reveal, Relativity). * Coordinating and communication with stakeholders such as Finance, Legal, HR, Compliance, IT, Security and external experts as appropriate. * Supporting OSI in identifying gaps in the control environment and proposing corrective actions. Analyzing individual and aggregated cases to identify recurring schemes, root causes, control weaknesses and opportunities to strengthen policies, procedures and preventive controls. * When investigation demand permits, performing self-service analytics and targeted detection activities based on prior cases, including analyses of expenses, procurement, third parties and other risk areas. Develop reusable tests, indicators, and investigative methods that improve early detection and investigation efficiency. * When no OSI investigations are ongoing, supporting Internal Audit assignments as agreed, while remaining fully available for reassignment to investigations at short notice. * Maintaining high-quality investigation files, contribute to consistent methodologies and templates, share lessons learned, coach colleagues, and continuously develop expertise in investigations, forensic accounting, analytics and relevant legal and professional requirements. * Providing timely updates to the OSI investigator and other authorized stakeholders. Communicate significant developments, evidence gaps, delays and constraints, and promptly escalate urgent legal, regulatory, financial, safety or reputational matters through the agreed channels. Leading the Forensic Audit team, train the team, update the team on developments and any other management activity required, including HR related matters such as the yearly appraisal process, develop the team’s expertise and knowledge. **Reporting Lines and Governance** ---------------------------------- * Reporting to the Head of Internal Audit and functional reporting to the Head of OSI. * Joint governance between Internal Audit and OSI for target setting, performance management, case allocation, availability and capacity management, and competence and career development. OSI owns and leads investigations; the forensic audit team performs investigative work under the agreed mandate and case governance. **Your background** * You combine strong investigative judgment with finance expertise, analytical curiosity and the confidence to communicate sensitive findings at senior levels. * Master's degree, preferably in economics, finance, accounting, business administration, or equivalent discipline. * Five to seven years of demonstrated experience in audit, finance, forensic accounting, data analytics or investigations, including at least three years leading investigations. * Strong knowledge of/ and experience related to investigation policies, methodologies and professional practices, including planning, evidence handling, interviewing, documentation, reporting, confidentiality and case closure. * Professional certification preferred, such as CFE, CFCS, CCEP, CAMS, CISA or CIA. * Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, sensitive stakeholders, and demanding due dates. * Demonstrated ability to resolve differences, exercise sound judgment, maintain independence, collaborate across functions and influence positive change. * Excellent command of English and outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels. Additional language skills, particularly Arabic, Mandarin, Spanish or Portuguese, are appreciated. * Strong SAP S/4HANA skills. Experience with Ariba, Concur, Power BI, Tableau or comparable solutions is preferred, together with the ability to perform practical data analysis and analytics. * Experience with eDiscovery, electronically stored information and digital evidence review. * Big Four or comparable forensic advisory experience is a plus. * Willingness to travel internationally up to 10%. * High degree of integrity, discretion, resilience, cultural awareness and commitment to fair, objective and well-documented investigations. **Accessibility and reasonable accommodation** **Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.** **Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment** **As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.** **Background Screening and Security Checks** **As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.** **For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. title: Regulatory Compliance

into daily operations — Support audits, inspections, and reviews — prep, respond, follow up — Drive ongoing due diligence and risk monitoring for merchants, partners, and providers. — Keep track of title: Product Management Senior Expert
description: **Company Description** *Work smart, have fun and make an impact!* **EcoVadis is the leading provider of business sustainability ratings**. Our solutions are backed by an international team of experts and powerful technology. We analyze data and build sustainability scorecards that give companies actionable insights into their environmental, social and ethical risks. **Why apply to EcoVadis?** Be a part of the global sustainability change in business. Grow your career. Work with extraordinary people. Feel valued for your contribution. Learn more about our team and culture on EcoVadis careers page. **Job Description** As a Senior Product Manager for one of our Strategic Use Cases, you will own that use case end-to-end — from the customer problem and the data it depends on, through prototype, roadmap and launch, to the outcome in the market. You will work alongside senior engineers and product experts to define the ambition, understand requirements and launch innovative new products. This is a builder role, not a coordination role. We're looking for a high-agency generalist who prototypes before they debate, uses AI to move at a different speed, engages customers directly, and takes full ownership of outcomes — not output. **What you'll be doing** * Own the vision: Set and drive the aligned, end-to-end vision for your use case (regulatory due diligence, human rights due diligence, decarbonization or resilience)— what the customer experience should be, where the gaps are, and the sequence from parity to leadership. * Understand the market: Understand the technical requirements of your use case, and how other competitors and customers are currently solving it. Take inspiration from everywhere, including partner discussions, conferences, webinars and other resources. * Engage customers directly: Spend real time with buyers, program owners and co-development accounts. Validate problems and solutions first-hand; and build interest from customers and prospects. * Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools to build working demos, spin up lightweight services and test your own assumptions before committing engineering. Show the team what's possible by doing it, not describing it. * Drive the build forward: Work alongside engineering to unblock and drive the build forward, working across multiple areas of the product and platform, collaborating with other tribes and squads whilst executing independently or in partnership. * Partner on go-to-market: Work hand-in-hand with the Strategic Use Case Leads and commercial teams to land what you build. * Own the outcome: Define the measures of success, hold yourself and the circle to them, and lead clean persist / pivot / stop decisions. **Who you are** * A generalist builder at heart — you move fluidly between strategy, data, prototype and GTM, and you'd rather build a rough thing that teaches you something than debate a perfect thing that doesn't. * An AI-native operator — AI is woven through how you work: discovery, analysis, prototyping, instrumentation and communication. * Customer-obsessed — you get your conviction from talking to real customers, not from the building. * Biased to speed — you move decisively with incomplete information, tell reversible decisions from irreversible ones, and update fast when you're wrong. Strong opinions, loosely held. * Comfortable without full control — part of your use case's scope and experience will always be owned by other squads. You see managing that, as the craft. * Mission-driven — you want your work to help guide all companies toward a sustainable world, and to help EcoVadis lead the market in getting there. **AI fluency we hire for** We expect you to operate at the AI-Fluent to AI-Native end of the spectrum: you don't just use AI for one-off tasks, you reconstruct core PM workflows around it — agents configured with your product context, personas and prior research; machine-testable acceptance criteria; reusable workflows you share with the squad. At the top of this ladder, the PM shifts from feature author to outcome orchestrator — concentrating on strategic trade-offs and novel bets while agents carry more of the discovery and synthesis. **Qualifications** * Typically 10+ years experience, including a track record owning a meaningful product area end-to-end in B2B enterprise SaaS, with real business and customer outcomes to point to. * Enough technical fluency to build — you can prototype with AI tooling, LLM APIs and a scripting language (Python / JavaScript or equivalent) without waiting for engineering to validate every idea. * An AI-native way of working that's already part of how you operate, not an aspiration. * Comfort operating in a regulated, data-rich, sustainability or risk domain — or the curiosity and speed to get there fast. * Sharp problem framing and communication — you walk into the room with a recommendation, not an open question, and you make engineering and design faster by reducing ambiguity. * Be fluent in English (as our primary working language). **Additional Information** * Contract of employment only * 2 office days per week is expected * Salary range shared before the first interview In return for your expertise, we offer: * Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment * Flexible working hours * Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing * Access to professional mental health support * Referral bonus policy * Learning and development * Sustainability events and community involvement * Peer recognition program * Employee-led resource groups * Optional (fully covered or co-financed) health care and life insurance * Multisport card * Multikafeteria * Lunch card * Hybrid work organization (2 office days per month) * Remote work from abroad policy * Internet and Electricity bill allowance * Additional day for community service when volunteering **Our hiring team looks forward to reviewing your resume, in English, with a guaranteed response to every application. A new job with purpose awaits you!** **Don’t meet all criteria?** Please apply anyway. We welcome diverse candidates and want to assess your skills and potential contribution to EcoVadis, regardless of your background. **Can the hiring process be adjusted to suit my needs?** Yes. We want all candidates, including people with disabilities, people with long-term health conditions, and neurodiverse applicants, to feel confident demonstrating their potential. If you require adjustments, such as interview questions in advance, please inform the hiring team. **Our team’s strength comes from everyone’s uniqueness and is founded upon mutual respect.** EcoVadis commits to equity, inclusion and reducing bias in our hiring processes. EcoVadis does not accept any form of discrimination based on characteristics such as color, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, beliefs, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, parental status, or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. To reduce bias in hiring, applicants are encouraged to remove personal details such as photos, marital/parental status, religion, gender, postal code, university name/graduation date, past leave details, and nationality (instead, confirm eligibility to work in the job location). **Our recruitment processes do not include AI systems that make autonomous decisions impacting individuals’ rights without human oversight.** Inputs and outputs of the system have been validated by humans and answers are based on algorithms that analyze previous data with which the system has been trained. We use SmartRecruiters as our applicant tracking system and to schedule interviews. Gemini is used to summarize notes from interviews and to refine job descriptions and social media messaging. AssessFirst is used to support talent assessment decisions.

title: Technical Team Lead, Hardware Security Platform
description: ##### **Project description** AMD is building a hardware-assisted security platform that uses silicon-level Performance Monitoring Counters (PMCs) and on-chip machine learning to detect advanced endpoint threats, including ransomware, fileless malware, and cryptojacking, at the processor layer, below OS-based evasion, on a Windows 11 endpoint platform. The platform collects CPU behavioral telemetry, classifies it through an ML inference engine, and exposes threat signals to security-software partners through a standardized API. The project covers the full engineering path from silicon telemetry and data generation through ML training and validation, low-latency Windows runtime integration, lab qualification, and partner integration. The Technical Team Lead will own the end-to-end technical direction of the platform and coordinate decisions across CPU telemetry, Windows systems software, machine learning, security validation, and partner-facing interfaces. This is a hands-on principal engineering role combining architecture ownership, technical leadership, and cross-functional delivery. The role requires regular on-site work in Gdańsk. Additional implementation details will be shared during the recruitment process in line with the applicable confidentiality requirements. ##### **Responsibilities** Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the hardware-assisted threat-detection platform, covering CPU telemetry collection, Windows systems components, ML inference, partner-facing SDK/API integration, and platform security mechanisms. Define the technical strategy, architectural boundaries, interfaces, and integration model across the Lab, ML, and Real-Time workstreams. Lead cross-functional architectural decisions involving processor telemetry, Windows kernel and user-space components, model inference, system performance, endpoint-security requirements, and partner integration. Establish and maintain technical quality standards, architecture principles, design-review practices, and engineering acceptance criteria. Define measurable efficacy and performance objectives, including detection quality, false-positive behavior, inference latency, system overhead, reliability, and API compatibility. Lead technical evaluation of trade-offs between model quality, telemetry coverage, runtime performance, implementation complexity, and system resource consumption. Own the technical strategy for the partner-facing SDK/API, including interface stability, versioning, compatibility, diagnostics, and integration guidance. Coordinate the technical relationship with approved security-software integration partners. Lead end-to-end validation gates across representative workloads, threat categories, system configurations, and hardware platforms. Ensure that technical decisions, interfaces, assumptions, risks, and known limitations are documented and traceable. Identify, communicate, and mitigate program-level technical risks and cross-workstream dependencies. Provide hands-on technical guidance and design support when complex issues span hardware, drivers, systems software, ML, and security. Mentor senior engineers across the Lab, ML, and Real-Time workstreams and help them resolve cross-disciplinary technical problems. Represent the platform in client architecture reviews, partner discussions, and approved external technical engagements. Work with project stakeholders to translate technical progress, constraints, and risks into clear decisions and priorities. Support the transition from Proof of Concept toward a scalable productization architecture if the initial phase is successful. ##### **Skills** Must have 8+ years of progressive software, systems, platform, hardware, security, or machine-learning engineering experience. Substantial experience operating as a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Senior Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, Systems Architect, or equivalent technical authority. Demonstrated hands-on technical depth in at least one of the following areas, with credible experience in at least one additional area: CPU and platform engineering: CPU microarchitecture, processor telemetry, PMCs/PMUs, performance profiling, platform firmware, UEFI/BIOS, silicon validation, or comparable low-level platform technologies. Windows systems and kernel engineering: Windows kernel-mode drivers, WDF/WDM/KMDF, driver-to-user-space communication, WinDbg, ETW/ETL, concurrency, low-latency systems, or performance-sensitive runtime development. Endpoint security: Endpoint-security or EDR architecture, system monitoring, behavioral detection, malware analysis, threat telemetry, security-agent development, or comparable defensive-security platforms. ML systems: Production ML inference pipelines, model-runtime integration, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, GPU/NPU inference, edge inference, or performance optimization for deployed ML models. Working literacy across the remaining technical areas and the ability to lead specialists without claiming equal hands-on depth in every discipline. Experience making and documenting architecture decisions across multiple components, engineering disciplines, or organizational boundaries. Experience leading a complex multi-disciplinary engineering effort from definition and prototype through integration and validation. Experience defining measurable technical KPIs, performance budgets, quality gates, acceptance criteria, or engineering readiness criteria. Ability to evaluate system-level trade-offs involving performance, reliability, security, compatibility, maintainability, and delivery risk. Strong technical communication skills across engineering, partner, project-management, and executive audiences. Ability to mentor senior engineers, facilitate design reviews, resolve technical disagreements, and drive decisions to closure. Ability to remain hands-on in architecture reviews, debugging, prototyping, performance analysis, or other technically complex work. Must be based in Gdańsk or willing to relocate to the Gdańsk area. University degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, cybersecurity, or an equivalent field. Nice to have Experience with hardware-assisted security technologies on a major processor architecture. Experience architecting endpoint-security, EDR, anti-malware, behavioral-detection, or system-monitoring products. Familiarity with hardware performance counters, processor telemetry, instruction-based sampling, or silicon-level performance analysis. Experience with Windows driver development, driver signing, HLK testing, or WHQL certification processes. Prior WHQL delivery is useful for later productization but is not required for the Proof-of-Concept phase. Experience integrating machine-learning inference into low-level, performance-sensitive, edge, endpoint, or embedded systems. Experience with ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, DirectML, GPU/NPU runtimes, model quantization, or inference-performance optimization. Experience developing SDKs or APIs for external engineering partners, including interface versioning and backward compatibility. Experience working with security-software vendors or managing joint technical integration programs. Experience with malware research, threat intelligence, safe sample handling, controlled security validation, or security-lab governance. Experience with silicon validation, firmware, UEFI/BIOS, hardware attestation, trusted execution, secure boot, or platform-rooted security. Experience defining detection-efficacy metrics, false-positive targets, performance budgets, or end-to-end validation gates. Experience moving an early-stage R&D or Proof-of-Concept system toward production architecture. Patent portfolio, technical publications, open-source contributions, conference presentations, or standards participation in a relevant technical area. ##### **Other** Languages English: C1 Advanced Seniority Lead Gdansk, Poland Req. title: Payroll, Time & Benefits Manager
description: Category: Finance Location: Warsaw, Mazowieckie, PL **Payroll, Time & Benefits Manager** **Department:** Payroll, Time & Benefits, People, Organisation & Corporate Affairs **Location:** Warsaw, Poland **Your impact begins here** As Payroll, Time & Benefits Manager, you will own payroll, time and benefits delivery for EMEA countries from our Regional Service Centre in Warsaw. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

description: Warsaw / Florence, Italy Core Operations – Core Products / International Contractor (B2B) / Remote **Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.** Nine countries. Fifteen people on the team. Not nearly enough of them free on Sundays. That's the gap you'd fill. Our system records linear TV channels and pulls out everything that might be an ad. Only a fraction of it actually is. The team, mostly contractors across Poland and Italy plus a few colleagues in the US, decides which clips are ads and which aren't, then tags the ones that are. We're adding another market in January, volume keeps growing, and right now the team is stretched thin. Sundays most of all. **What you'd actually do** Look at what the system flags, decide whether it's an ad, and apply the metadata, following the rulebook for that country. There are a lot of rules, and every market has its own. You'd start with a structured training block with Riccardo, then work the queue alongside the team. German is the language we're thinnest on, so that's the one we're hiring for first. It's repetitive, especially in the first weeks. ### **What you need to already be good at** * Fluent English and German. You'll work in both * Steady, structured work. Office, shifts, client-facing, whatever it was, you know what showing up consistently looks like * Attention to detail. You can follow a long rulebook and apply it the same way on the hundredth clip as on the first * 32–40 hours a week, **every Sunday** **Bonus points** French · Italian · Polish · Spanish · subtitling, transcription or localization QC · content moderation or data labelling · familiarity with TV advertising and brands **Not for you if** * "Information specialist" sounds like databases and queries to you. It's not that job. Nobody here will ask you to write SQL. * You need variety to stay engaged. You'll be making the same kind of decision all day. * Sundays are negotiable. They aren't, and we won't rotate them. * You're looking for a stopgap to leave in a few months. Training takes real time, and we're hiring someone to stay. **How we judge you, and how it goes** Skills we teach, attitude we don't. Every hire is scored on the same five things: determined yet resilient, naturally curious, low-ego, self-aware, results oriented. title: AR & Reconciliation Specialist
description: **About Talixo** Talixo is the world's leading operator of pre-booked transfers, working with the biggest brands in travel. We partner with fleets in 1,100+ cities and 130+ countries worldwide to provide travellers with reliable, high-quality rides, making their journeys easier and more enjoyable, from door to door. Since 2012, we've been helping travel brands create more connected journeys, and we're looking for people willing to go the extra mile. Operating across two key locations, Kraków and Berlin, our cohesive teams (IT, Operations, Fleet, Pricing, Sales, Finance and HR) drive technological innovation, operational excellence and organisational development. With a shared focus on refining processes and enhancing technology, while spearheading strategic growth initiatives, we seamlessly contribute to our collective success. **Mission** As our Accounts Receivable & Reconciliation Lead, you will own every euro that comes into Talixo: from the invoice leaving our systems to the cash landing in our account, fully reconciled. You'll make sure our customers and partners are invoiced correctly and pay on time, and when the numbers don't match, you'll find out why. You will act as the key link between Finance and our Sales, Quality, Support, Operations and Pricing teams, combining hands-on execution, root-cause problem-solving and a drive to automate. Our Finance team is lean, so you'll keep these processes running reliably at all times, give leadership a clear view of the cash still to come, and make the work less manual every quarter, including by building small tools yourself. You will report to the Head of Finance Operations. **Key Responsibilities** **1. Customer Invoicing** * Prepare, validate, and issue customer invoices each billing cycle, on time and complete. * Ensure pricing, commissions and contractual terms are applied correctly. * Validate the underlying data: rides, partners and adjustments. * Handle invoice corrections and credit notes, with documented reasons. * Make sure every customer receives their invoices, and fix delivery issues when they don't. * Set up new customers correctly for invoicing and payment (billing data, payment terms, CRM setup) and join finance onboarding calls where needed. **2. Cash Collection & Credit Control** * Monitor all incoming payments across bank accounts and payment providers daily, and match them to open invoices. * Follow up actively on overdue invoices and run the dunning process consistently. * Agree payment plans or next steps with customers, within agreed limits. * Handle card payment chargebacks (e.g. Stripe, Adyen) on time. * Set and review credit limits and payment terms, and decide within agreed rules when a customer should move to prepayment. * Propose bad-debt provisions and write-offs, and hand unresolved cases to a collection agency or legal. * Flag high-value or high-risk cases early to the Head of Finance Operations. **3. Reconciliation** * Reconcile customer accounts continuously: what was invoiced against what was paid. * Reconcile platform and partner settlements against our billing data. * Identify short payments, penalties, deductions, duplicates, currency differences, dig into every discrepancy until the root cause is clear, and work with internal teams to fix it for good. * Keep the reconciliation backlog under control and trending down. * Reconcile the AR ledger to the general ledger at month-end and give input on unbilled revenue. **4. Cash Forecasting & Reporting** * Build and maintain a rolling short-term cash-in forecast based on open receivables, payment terms, customer payment behaviour and partner settlement schedules. * Compare forecast against actual cash-in, explain the differences, and flag liquidity risks early to the Head of Finance Operations. * Maintain AR aging reports, overdue tracking and AR KPIs, giving management full transparency on cash inflow and risks. * Provide clean, structured and complete AR data to Accounting for month-end and year-end closing. * Support external auditors and internal reporting requirements with audit-ready AR documentation, and provide AR input for management and investor reporting. **5. Process Automation** * Drive larger automation of payment matching, dunning and reconciliation preparation together with Finance Systems & Data. * Use AI tools in your daily work: matching, data cleanup, drafting customer emails, summarising disputes. * Build and maintain the AR dashboards used by Finance and management. * Make sure every tool and automation is documented and monitored, so it keeps running when you're away. **What Success Looks Like** Success in this role means: * **Clean billing:** every billing cycle runs on time, and customers receive correct invoices. * **Healthy cash flow:** payments come in on time, overdue balances and DSO trend down, and risks are flagged before they become losses. * **Predictable cash-in:** leadership can rely on your short-term forecast of incoming payments. * **Numbers that match:** customer and partner accounts are reconciled, and the backlog shrinks month by month. * **Fixed for good:** discrepancies are resolved quickly with clear ownership, and recurring root causes are removed. * **No interruptions:** invoicing and collections run without delay, including when you're away. * **Less manual work:** processes become increasingly automated, structured and scalable. * **Full visibility:** management and Accounting get clean, timely data on receivables, cash inflow and risks. **Your first 90 days** * **Days 1–60:** learn the billing cycles, payment flows and partner settlements; run one full cycle with support. * **Days 60-90:** own the cycle end to end and clean up the reconciliation backlog. * **Days 90+:** automate the first process, e.g. payment matching or dunning, and agree KPI targets for the next two quarters. **Ideal Profile** * 3–6 years in accounts receivable, credit control or order-to-cash * Proven ownership of collections, credit control and customer reconciliations, not only support * Experience with high invoice volumes and many customers, ideally B2B or platform businesses * Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; You'll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning, to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued. The role contributes to contract management, corporate governance, regulatory compliance support, and legal documentation, in alignment with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies governing clinical research activities. More specifically, the legal specialist must: * Assist in the preparation, review, coordination, and administration of contracts related to clinical research activities, including but not limited to: Clinical Trial Agreements (CTAs) , Confidential Disclosure Agreements (CDAs) , Vendor and consultant agreements , Amendments and contract addenda * Coordinate contract execution workflows, including tracking signatures, versions, and approvals. * Maintain and update contract databases, trackers, and document management systems. * Support legal compliance activities related to clinical trials, including documentation required for audits, inspections, and due diligence processes. * Conduct legal and regulatory research related to healthcare, clinical research, data protection, and corporate law as required. * Privacy compliance support, completing and tracking privacy assessments, DPIAs, and other required documentation. * Support the Legal Department in responding to internal inquiries related to contracts, policies, and legal processes. * Assist in the development, updating, and organization of legal templates, SOPs, policies, and training materials. * Liaise with internal stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Finance, Procurement, HR, Quality, etc.) to ensure timely and accurate legal support. * Coordinate with external counsel, notaries, and regulatory bodies when required. * Ensure confidentiality, accuracy, and compliance with applicable regulations (e.g., GCP, privacy laws, contractual obligations). Requirements: * Diploma or certificate in Paralegal Studies or equivalent legal training. * Minimum of 3–5 years of experience as a paralegal or legal assistant, preferably in a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotech, or regulated environment. * Different combinations of relevant education and work experience will be considered * Strong understanding of contract administration and legal documentation. * Familiarity with clinical research operations, GCP, and regulatory frameworks. * Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. * High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and contract/document management systems. Brand name: Indero Our company: **The work environment** **At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.** **In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:** * Permanent full-time position * Vacation, PPK, health allowance * Home-based position with teleworking allowance * Ongoing learning and development **Work location** **This position is opened to candidates across Poland (home-based position).** **Recruitment process: what to expect** * As part of the recruitment process for this position you will meet various team members at Indero * The first interview will be conducted by phone (20 minutes) and the second via video conference (1 hour) * The second interview includes a short presentation for which reasonable advance preparation is required (preparation is not timed and can be completed over a few days). You may think of it as one interview question for which you have the opportunity to develop a strong structured response that goes beyond the surface. **About Indero** **Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and rheumatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.** ***Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.*** ***Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Poland.***
